literature.headline_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期重点文献按发表日期、相关性、证据等级和研究质量综合排序，研究结果与综述证据分别核验后形成以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 乙型肝炎知晓率汇总为 75.3%(95% CI:61.5%-86.9%),存在显着异质性(I2=99.24%)。乌干达中部地区的意识显着高于北部、东部和西部地区,医护人员的意识也明显高于普通民众和产前护理人员。在暴露后预防和完成完整乙肝疫苗接种计划方面仍然存在知识差距。 [10.1186/s12879-026-14019-6]
对于乙型肝炎,37.7% 的人报告了当前的治疗或管理,而 53.6% 的人报告了转诊或评估正在进行中;对于 HCV,这些比例分别为 33.3% 和 54.7%。 [10.33321/cdi.2026.50.047]
结构方程模型显示,行为态度和主观规范是药物依从性最强的预测因素,两者都间接影响行为(相关系数:分别为 0.13 × 0.66 = 0.09 和 0.39 × 0.66 = 0.25)。 [10.1177/20473087261470051]

血清学确诊的抗-HBs阳性率为51.10%(1,208/2,364),远低于世界卫生组织建议的70%阈值。空间分析显示,地理异质性显着(χ2 = 74.38,P < 0.001),免疫力较高的地区集中在规模较大的工业带(67.33%),免疫力较低的地区集中在分散的服务业区(36.81%)。SEM 结果表明,虽然外部线索强烈预测 HBV 知识(β = 0.894),但知识对预防意图只有边际影响(β = 0.192)。预防意图显着预测实际行为(β = 0.655)。 [10.1186/s12889-026-28627-z]
重要的是,慢性 HBV 感染减少了肝脏常规 NK (cNK) 细胞(肝脏 CCL5 的主要来源)的数量,而肝脏驻留 NK (LrNK) 细胞增加并表现出较低的 CCL5 表达和免疫抑制特征。 [10.1002/advs.76696]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.caveats_zh: 部分证据来自摘要、观察性研究或叙述性综述，结论应结合研究设计和证据等级理解。

key_findings_en: The pooled prevalence of HBV awareness was 75.3% (95% CI: 61.5%-86.9%), with substantial heterogeneity (I2=99.24%). Awareness was significantly higher in Central Uganda than in northern, eastern, and western regions, and among healthcare workers compared to the general population and antenatal care attendees. [10.1186/s12879-026-14019-6]
For HBV, 37.7% reported current treatment or management, while 53.6% reported referral or assessment in progress; for HCV, these proportions were 33.3% and 54.7%. [10.33321/cdi.2026.50.047]

The structural equation model revealed behavioral attitude and subjective norms as the strongest predictors of medication adherence, both of which indirectly affected behavior (correlation coefficients: 0.13 × 0.66 = 0.09 and 0.39 × 0.66 = 0.25, respectively). [10.1177/20473087261470051]
The serologically confirmed anti-HBs positive rate was 51.10% (1,208/2,364), substantially lower than the 70% threshold recommended by the World Health Organization. [10.1186/s12889-026-28627-z]

Importantly, chronic HBV infection reduced the number of hepatic conventional NK (cNK) cells, the main source of hepatic CCL5, whereas liver‐resident NK (LrNK) cells increased and exhibited lower CCL5 expression and immunosuppressive features. [10.1002/advs.76696]
literature.trend_or_risk_en: The direction of this week's research is defined by the clinical, epidemiological, ecological, diagnostic and molecular topics actually represented by the eligible publications.
literature.caveats_en: Some evidence is abstract-only, observational or derived from narrative reviews; conclusions should be interpreted in light of study design and evidence strength.

news.headline_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期新闻资格由来源、日期、正文身份和相关性终审决定；中文翻译状态不影响有效新闻的保留。中文字段不可用时，本区域使用已核验英文内容填充。
key_findings_zh: 控制和消除乙型肝炎的公共卫生运动,评估实现 2030 年消除目标的进展情况。据《中国日报》报道,这是一场官员和临床医生齐聚北京的媒体活动。 [news-ae2a1e09a2339c64]
研究人员发现,CT 测量的内脏脂肪和肌肉的变化可以预测慢性乙型肝炎相关肝硬化的严重肝脏并发症。研究结果发表在《肝胆通讯》杂志上。 [news-17c80d8f6fc1d77f]
验尸官呼吁对乙型肝炎再激活处方提供更多指导 - 化学家+药剂师。 [news-9544f598a722feee]

papers.title: Correlates of hepatitis B virus awareness and disease specific knowledge in Uganda: a meta-analysis and meta-regression of studies published between 2018 and 2025
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a major public health challenge in Uganda, where prevalence varies by region and population group despite national vaccination and screening initiatives. Understanding awareness and knowledge levels is essential for guiding HBV prevention and control strategies. This study synthesized available evidence on the correlates of HBV awareness and disease specific knowledge among different Ugandan populations. METHODS: We systematically searched PubMed, African Journals Online (AJOL), and Google Scholar for cross-sectional studies reporting on HBV awareness or disease-specific knowledge in Uganda, published between January 2018 and December 2025. Study selection, data extraction, and quality appraisal were conducted independently by two reviewers using the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) Critical Appraisal Checklist for Analytical Cross-Sectional Studies. Eighteen studies meeting the eligibility criteria were included in the final synthesis. Pooled estimates of HBV awareness and correlates of disease-specific knowledge were computed using a random-effects model in MedCalc software (version 10.10), with heterogeneity quantified using the I2 statistic. Sources of heterogeneity were explored through subgroup analysis and sensitivity analysis. Meta-regression was performed to examine trends in HBV awareness by region, year of publication, and study population. Publication bias was assessed using Begg's and Egger's tests. Statistical significance was set at p < 0.05, and all estimates are reported with 95% confidence intervals. RESULTS: Eighteen studies met the inclusion criteria. The pooled prevalence of HBV awareness was 75.3% (95% CI: 61.5%-86.9%), with substantial heterogeneity observed across regions and population groups (I2=99.24%). Subgroup analysis revealed that awareness was significantly higher in Central Uganda compared to the northern, eastern, and western regions (p < 0.05), and among healthcare workers compared to the general population and antenatal care attendees (p < 0.05). Knowledge of specific HBV domains varied considerably: awareness of the causative agent, screening services, and vaccination availability was significantly higher among knowledgeable participants compared to those with no prior HBV knowledge (p < 0.05), whereas awareness of post-exposure prophylaxis and completion of the full HBV vaccination schedule remained low compared to those who had received at least partial vaccination (p < 0.05). Awareness of key transmission routes including sexual contact, needle sharing, and mother-to-child transmission was moderate, though knowledge of transmission through infected body fluids remained poor. Participants who were of higher education level were more likely to take up vaccination compared to lower education level (p < 0.05), and participants with a positive attitude toward vaccine effectiveness were significantly more likely to be vaccinated compared to those with a negative attitude (p < 0.05). The meta-regression analysis further revealed a paradoxical overall decline in HBV awareness over the study period. CONCLUSION: Critical gaps still persist in HBV awareness and key knowledge areas highlighting the need for alternative strategies tailored to the social dynamics of the current generation during the delivery of health messages. CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: Not applicable.

Awareness was higher in Central Uganda and among healthcare workers compared to other regions and populations. Knowledge gaps persisted in post-exposure prophylaxis and vaccination schedule completion, while awareness of transmission routes varied. Meta-regression indicated a paradoxical decline in HBV awareness over time. The study underscores the need for tailored public health strategies to address regional and population-specific disparities in HBV awareness and knowledge.

papers.title_zh: 乌干达乙型肝炎病毒认识与疾病特定知识的相关性:对 2018 年至 2025 年发表的研究进行荟萃分析和荟萃回归
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a major public health challenge in Uganda, where prevalence varies by region and population group despite national vaccination and screening initiatives. Understanding awareness and knowledge levels is essential for guiding HBV prevention and control strategies. This study synthesized available evidence on the correlates of HBV awareness and disease specific knowledge among different Ugandan populations. METHODS: We systematically searched PubMed, African Journals Online (AJOL), and Google Scholar for cross-sectional studies reporting on HBV awareness or disease-specific knowledge in Uganda, published between January 2018 and December 2025. Study selection, data extraction, and quality appraisal were conducted independently by two reviewers using the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) Critical Appraisal Checklist for Analytical Cross-Sectional Studies. Eighteen studies meeting the eligibility criteria were included in the final synthesis. Pooled estimates of HBV awareness and correlates of disease-specific knowledge were computed using a random-effects model in MedCalc software (version 10.10), with heterogeneity quantified using the I2 statistic. Sources of heterogeneity were explored through subgroup analysis and sensitivity analysis. Meta-regression was performed to examine trends in HBV awareness by region, year of publication, and study population. Publication bias was assessed using Begg's and Egger's tests. Statistical significance was set at p < 0.05, and all estimates are reported with 95% confidence intervals. RESULTS: Eighteen studies met the inclusion criteria. The pooled prevalence of HBV awareness was 75.3% (95% CI: 61.5%-86.9%), with substantial heterogeneity observed across regions and population groups (I2=99.24%). Subgroup analysis revealed that awareness was significantly higher in Central Uganda compared to the northern, eastern, and western regions (p < 0.05), and among healthcare workers compared to the general population and antenatal care attendees (p < 0.05). Knowledge of specific HBV domains varied considerably: awareness of the causative agent, screening services, and vaccination availability was significantly higher among knowledgeable participants compared to those with no prior HBV knowledge (p < 0.05), whereas awareness of post-exposure prophylaxis and completion of the full HBV vaccination schedule remained low compared to those who had received at least partial vaccination (p < 0.05). Awareness of key transmission routes including sexual contact, needle sharing, and mother-to-child transmission was moderate, though knowledge of transmission through infected body fluids remained poor. Participants who were of higher education level were more likely to take up vaccination compared to lower education level (p < 0.05), and participants with a positive attitude toward vaccine effectiveness were significantly more likely to be vaccinated compared to those with a negative attitude (p < 0.05). The meta-regression analysis further revealed a paradoxical overall decline in HBV awareness over the study period. CONCLUSION: Critical gaps still persist in HBV awareness and key knowledge areas highlighting the need for alternative strategies tailored to the social dynamics of the current generation during the delivery of health messages. CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: Not applicable.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)仍然是乌干达的一个主要公共卫生挑战,尽管国家采取了疫苗接种和筛查举措,但其患病率因地区和人群而异。了解意识和知识水平对于指导乙肝预防和控制策略至关重要。这项研究综合了乌干达不同人群对乙肝病毒的认识和疾病具体知识之间的相关性的现有证据。方法:我们系统地检索了 PubMed、非洲期刊在线 (AJOL) 和 Google Scholar,查找 2018 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月期间发表的关于乌干达 HBV 认知或特定疾病知识的横断面研究。研究选择、数据提取和质量评估由两名评审员使用 Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) 分析横断面研究批判评估清单独立进行。最终综合报告中纳入了十八项符合资格标准的研究。使用 MedCalc 软件(版本 10.10)中的随机效应模型计算 HBV 认知度和特定疾病知识相关性的汇总估计,并使用 I2 统计量量化异质性。通过亚组分析和敏感性分析探讨异质性的来源。进行元回归以检查按地区、出版年份和研究人群划分的 HBV 认知趋势。使用 Begg 和 Egger 测试评估发表偏倚。统计显着性设置为 p < 0.05,所有估计值均以 95% 置信区间报告。结果:十八项研究符合纳入标准。乙型肝炎知晓率汇总率为 75.3%(95% CI:61.5%-86.9%),不同地区和人群之间存在显着异质性(I2=99.24%)。亚组分析显示,与北部、东部和西部地区相比,乌干达中部地区的知晓率显着较高(p < 0.05),与一般人群和产前护理人员相比,医护人员的知晓率显着较高(p < 0.05)。对特定 HBV 领域的了解差异很大:与先前没有 HBV 知识的参与者相比,知识丰富的参与者对病原体、筛查服务和疫苗接种可用性的认识显着较高 (p < 0.05),而与至少接受部分疫苗接种的参与者相比,对暴露后预防和完成完整 HBV 疫苗接种计划的认识仍然较低 (p < 0.05)。尽管对通过受感染体液传播的了解仍然很少,但对性接触、共用针头和母婴传播等关键传播途径的了解程度较低。与教育水平较低的参与者相比,受教育程度较高的参与者更有可能接种疫苗(p < 0.05),对疫苗有效性持积极态度的参与者比持消极态度的参与者更有可能接种疫苗(p < 0.05)。荟萃回归分析进一步揭示了研究期间乙肝病毒认知度整体下降的矛盾现象。结论:对乙肝病毒的认识和关键知识领域仍然存在严重差距,这突出表明在传播健康信息时需要针对当代社会动态制定替代策略。临床试验编号:不适用。

papers.title: Trends in Hepatitis B, Hepatitis C, and HIV Seroprevalence in the Netherlands: Insights From Two Decades of Nationwide PIENTER Serosurveys
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Hepatitis B (HBV), hepatitis C (HCV), and HIV remain public health challenges despite effective treatments and preventive options. Infections are often asymptomatic, leading to undiagnosed cases, onward transmission, and preventable morbidity and mortality. In the Netherlands, disease burden is concentrated in specific populations, with many undetected infections. We estimated HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence, identified determinants, and assessed trends over 20 years using data from 14,444 participants aged 15–79 years from three nationwide cross‐sectional serosurveys (PIENTER: 1995–1996, 2006–2007, and 2016–2017). Participants completed questionnaires on demographics, behaviour, and socio‐economic factors, and serum samples were tested for HBV and HCV in all rounds and HIV in 2017. Seroprevalence estimates were weighted to the Dutch population, trends were analysed using weighted Poisson regression, and determinants were evaluated using multivariable Poisson regression. Weighted HBV seroprevalence remained stable across surveys (3%–5% past or present infection; < 0.4% active infection). HBV prevalence was highest among first‐generation migrants, with older age, migration background, and STI history as key determinants. HCV seroprevalence remained low (< 0.4%) and was highest among non‐Western migrants. HIV prevalence was 0.1% and highest among non‐Western migrants and men who have sex with men. Only 9% of active HBV cases were aware of their status. Overall, HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence remain low in the Netherlands but are concentrated in specific groups with limited awareness. These findings support targeted prevention, screening, and linkage‐to‐care strategies to achieve the 2030 WHO elimination goals and highlight the importance of continued population‐based (sero‐)monitoring to guide public health policy.
authors: Christine G. J. I. van Straten
Fiona R. M. van der Klis
Eline L. M. Op de Coul

source_records.title: Trends in Hepatitis B, Hepatitis C, and HIV Seroprevalence in the Netherlands: Insights From Two Decades of Nationwide PIENTER Serosurveys
source_records.abstract: ABSTRACT Hepatitis B (HBV), hepatitis C (HCV), and HIV remain public health challenges despite effective treatments and preventive options. Infections are often asymptomatic, leading to undiagnosed cases, onward transmission, and preventable morbidity and mortality. In the Netherlands, disease burden is concentrated in specific populations, with many undetected infections. We estimated HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence, identified determinants, and assessed trends over 20 years using data from 14,444 participants aged 15–79 years from three nationwide cross‐sectional serosurveys (PIENTER: 1995–1996, 2006–2007, and 2016–2017). Participants completed questionnaires on demographics, behaviour, and socio‐economic factors, and serum samples were tested for HBV and HCV in all rounds and HIV in 2017. Seroprevalence estimates were weighted to the Dutch population, trends were analysed using weighted Poisson regression, and determinants were evaluated using multivariable Poisson regression. Weighted HBV seroprevalence remained stable across surveys (3%–5% past or present infection; < 0.4% active infection). HBV prevalence was highest among first‐generation migrants, with older age, migration background, and STI history as key determinants. HCV seroprevalence remained low (< 0.4%) and was highest among non‐Western migrants. HIV prevalence was 0.1% and highest among non‐Western migrants and men who have sex with men. Only 9% of active HBV cases were aware of their status. Overall, HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence remain low in the Netherlands but are concentrated in specific groups with limited awareness. These findings support targeted prevention, screening, and linkage‐to‐care strategies to achieve the 2030 WHO elimination goals and highlight the importance of continued population‐based (sero‐)monitoring to guide public health policy.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV), and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) in the Netherlands, focusing on seroprevalence trends, determinants, and population-level burden over two decades among individuals aged 15–79 years, with a central question on identifying high-risk groups and informing targeted public health strategies.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review synthesizes data from three nationwide cross-sectional serosurveys (PIENTER: 1995–1996, 2006–2007, 2016–2017) involving 14,444 participants, using weighted seroprevalence estimates, Poisson regression for trend analysis, and multivariable regression to assess determinants, with serum samples tested for HBV and HCV in all rounds and HIV in 2017.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence in the Netherlands remain low overall (< 0.4% for HCV and HIV; 3%–5% for past or present HBV infection), with stable trends over 20 years, but highlights concentrated burden in specific groups such as first-generation migrants, non-Western migrants, and men who have sex with men, alongside low awareness of active HBV infection (9%).
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review identifies limited awareness of active HBV infection as a critical evidence gap, with only 9% of cases aware of their status, and notes that the low overall prevalence contrasts with the high burden in specific populations, suggesting potential underdiagnosis or underreporting in these groups.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review emphasizes the need for targeted prevention, screening, and linkage-to-care strategies to achieve WHO 2030 elimination goals, and underscores the importance of continued population-based seromonitoring to guide public health policy and resource allocation.

analysis.summary_en: This review synthesizes two decades of nationwide serosurvey data (PIENTER) from 14,444 Dutch participants aged 15–79 years to assess trends in hepatitis B, hepatitis C, and HIV seroprevalence. Weighted estimates and regression analyses reveal stable low prevalence overall (< 0.4% for HCV/HIV; 3%–5% for HBV past/present infection), with concentrated burden in first-generation migrants, non-Western migrants, and men who have sex with men. Only 9% of active HBV cases are aware of their status, highlighting a critical gap in diagnosis. The review concludes that targeted prevention and screening are essential to meet WHO elimination targets and calls for sustained seromonitoring to inform policy.

elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该审查强调需要采取有针对性的预防、筛查和与护理挂钩的战略,以实现世卫组织 2030 年消除目标,并强调持续进行基于人群的血清监测以指导公共卫生政策和资源分配的重要性。

papers.title: Quality of life and self-reported stigma following hepatitis B surface antigen loss: A multi-site study by the Canadian Hepatitis B Network
papers.abstract: Abstract Background: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) imposes adverse health outcomes but may also cause psychosocial and quality-of-life (QOL) challenges. Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) loss, whether spontaneous or due to treatment (ie, a functional cure), is associated with improved clinical outcomes, but the impact of HBsAg clearance on patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) is poorly understood. Methods: Two surveys (hepatitis B self-stigma and hepatitis B–related QOL [HBQOL]) were administered to adults with a history of CHB with documented HBsAg clearance from six Canadian hepatology clinics. Results: Eighty-four participants were enrolled (median age: 60 years; 53.6% male). Nearly three quarters (72.6%) of patients reported never feeling self-stigma. HBQOL scores improved across all six domains ( p < 0.001 for each), with the largest relative gains in psychological well-being (60% reduction), transmission concerns (55%), and stigma (53%). Conclusions: HBsAg loss was associated with significant improvements in patient-reported stigma and QOL. These findings highlight the importance of incorporating PROMs into hepatitis B virus clinical care to better capture treatment experiences.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要背景:慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 会带来不良的健康结果,但也可能导致心理社会和生活质量 (QOL) 挑战。乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 丧失,无论是自发的还是由于治疗(即功能性治愈)导致的,都与临床结果的改善相关,但 HBsAg 清除率对患者报告的结果测量 (PROM) 的影响知之甚少。方法:对有慢性乙型肝炎病史且有来自加拿大六个肝病诊所的 HBsAg 清除记录的成年人进行两项调查(乙型肝炎自我污名和乙型肝炎相关生活质量 [HBQOL])。结果:共有 84 名参与者入组(中位年龄:60 岁;53.6% 为男性)。近四分之三(72.6%)的患者表示从未感到自我耻辱。所有六个领域的 HBQOL 分数均有所改善(每个领域 p < 0.001),其中心理健康(减少 60%)、传播担忧(55%)和耻辱(53%)方面的相对收益最大。结论:HBsAg 消失与患者报告的耻辱感和生活质量的显着改善相关。这些发现强调了将 PROM 纳入乙型肝炎病毒临床护理以更好地获取治疗经验的重要性。

papers.title: Hepatitis B Vaccination in People Living with HIV: Bridging the Immunological Gap
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major driver of liver-related morbidity and mortality among people living with HIV (PLWH), yet vaccine-induced protection is frequently suboptimal. HIV-associated immune dysfunction, including CD4+ T-cell depletion, altered antigen presentation, impaired T follicular helper cell support, and B-cell dysregulation, reduces seroprotection after standard recombinant HBV vaccines and may limit durability of antibody responses. Vaccine response is further influenced by HIV viral suppression, age, comorbidities, prior vaccine history, and baseline HBV serologic status, including isolated hepatitis B core antibody (anti-HBc) and occult HBV infection (OBI) considerations. Although antiretroviral therapy (ART) improves vaccine responsiveness, many PLWH fail to achieve protective hepatitis B surface antibody (anti-HBs) titers (≥10 mIU/mL) after conventional schedules, or experience antibody waning over time. Current guidelines recommend HBV vaccination for all susceptible PLWH with post-vaccination serologic testing and revaccination for nonresponders. Persistent implementation barriers, including incomplete series, vaccine hesitancy, stigma, and logistical constraints, continue to limit real-world impact. Emerging clinical trial data support CpG-adjuvanted HBV vaccines (HepB-CpG/Heplisav-B) and intensified dosing and schedules (double-dose or four-dose regimens) to improve seroprotection and generate higher peak anti-HBs titers, which may enhance durability. This review synthesizes guideline recommendations, immunologic mechanisms of hyporesponsiveness, predictors of vaccine response, and practical strategies to optimize HBV vaccination in PLWH.

papers.abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染仍然是艾滋病毒感染者 (PLWH) 肝脏相关发病率和死亡率的主要驱动因素,但疫苗诱导的保护往往不理想。HIV 相关的免疫功能障碍,包括 CD4+ T 细胞耗竭、抗原呈递改变、滤泡辅助 T 细胞支持受损和 B 细胞失调,会降低标准重组 HBV 疫苗后的血清保护作用,并可能限制抗体反应的持久性。疫苗反应进一步受到 HIV 病毒抑制、年龄、合并症、既往疫苗史和基线 HBV 血清学状态的影响,包括分离的乙型肝炎核心抗体(抗 HBc)和隐匿性 HBV 感染 (OBI) 考虑因素。尽管抗逆转录病毒治疗 (ART) 可以提高疫苗反应性,但许多感染者在常规治疗后未能达到保护性乙型肝炎表面抗体 (抗 HBs) 滴度 (≥10 mIU/mL),或者随着时间的推移抗体逐渐减弱。目前的指南建议对所有易感感染者进行乙型肝炎疫苗接种,并进行疫苗接种后血清学检测,并对无反应者重新接种疫苗。持续存在的实施障碍,包括不完整的系列、疫苗犹豫、耻辱和后勤限制,继续限制现实世界的影响。新的临床试验数据支持 CpG 佐剂 HBV 疫苗 (HepB-CpG/Heplisav-B) 和强化剂量和方案(双剂量或四剂量方案),以改善血清保护并产生更高的峰值抗 HBs 滴度,这可能会增强耐久性。本综述综合了指南建议、低反应性的免疫机制、疫苗反应的预测因素以及优化 PLWH 乙型肝炎疫苗接种的实用策略。

papers.title: Structural barriers drive the intention-action gap in hepatitis B prevention among migrants in Shandong Province, China: a triangulated study of serological, spatial, and behavioral data
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major public health challenge in China. Migrant workers constitute a highly vulnerable population due to high geographic mobility and occupational vulnerability. Despite public health education efforts, a notable intention-action gap disrupts the HBV care cascade. This study integrates serological, spatial, and behavioral data to investigate whether this gap is primarily driven by cognitive deficits or interrupted by underlying structural barriers. METHODS: A triangulated cross-sectional study was conducted in Yantai, China, involving structured questionnaire surveys (N = 1,184) and serological testing (N = 2,364). The spatial distribution of regional anti-HBs positive rates was mapped using Geographic Information Systems (GIS). An adapted Health Belief Model was tested using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) with a Robust Maximum Likelihood estimator to evaluate the disruptive effects of objective structural constraints-specifically, time poverty, economic constraints, and systemic lack of medical insurance. RESULTS: The serologically confirmed anti-HBs positive rate was 51.10% (1,208/2,364), substantially lower than the 70% threshold recommended by the World Health Organization. Spatial analysis revealed significant geographic heterogeneity (χ2 = 74.38, P < 0.001), with higher immunity concentrated in large-scale industrial belts (67.33%) and lower immunity clustered in dispersed service-sector districts (36.81%). SEM results indicated that while external cues strongly predicted HBV knowledge (β = 0.894), knowledge had only a marginal effect on preventive intention (β = 0.192). Preventive intention significantly predicted actual behavior (β = 0.655). However, this motivational process was severely undermined by structural barriers, predominantly time poverty (β = -0.563, P < 0.001), followed by economic constraints (β = -0.278, P < 0.001) and lack of medical insurance (β = -0.056, P = 0.030). CONCLUSIONS: The intention-action gap in HBV prevention among migrant workers is primarily driven by socioeconomic structural barriers-most notably time poverty-while basic HBV knowledge remains a foundational but insufficient condition for preventive action. Achieving the goal of viral hepatitis elimination requires a shift from individual cognitive persuasion to structural interventions, emphasizing workplace-based service delivery, spatially targeted resource allocation, and insurance reforms to alleviate out-of-pocket and opportunity costs.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染仍然是中国的一个重大公共卫生挑战,而农民工由于地域流动性大和职业脆弱性而构成高度脆弱的人群。这项研究整合了血清学、空间和行为数据,以调查乙型肝炎预防中的意图与行动差距是否主要是由认知缺陷驱动的,还是被潜在的结构障碍所中断。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在中国烟台进行了一项三角横断面研究,包括结构化问卷调查(N = 1,184)和血清学检测(N = 2,364)。
elements_zh.methods: 使用地理信息系统 (GIS) 绘制区域抗 HBs 阳性率的空间分布。使用结构方程模型 (SEM) 和鲁棒最大似然估计器对改编后的健康信念模型进行测试,以评估客观结构约束(特别是时间贫困、经济约束和系统性缺乏医疗保险)的破坏性影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 血清学确诊的抗-HBs阳性率为51.10%(1,208/2,364),远低于世界卫生组织建议的70%阈值。空间分析显示,地理异质性显着(χ2 = 74.38,P < 0.001),免疫力较高的地区集中在规模较大的工业带(67.33%),免疫力较低的地区集中在分散的服务业区(36.81%)。SEM 结果表明,虽然外部线索强烈预测 HBV 知识(β = 0.894),但知识对预防意图只有边际影响(β = 0.192)。预防意图显着预测实际行为(β = 0.655)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 农民工乙肝预防的意向与行动差距主要是由社会经济结构性障碍(尤其是时间贫困)造成的,而基本的乙肝知识仍然是预防行动的基础但不充分的条件。该研究独特地整合了血清学、空间和行为数据,证明结构性限制,而不是认知缺陷,是乙型肝炎护理级联的主要干扰因素。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 实现消除病毒性肝炎的目标需要从个人认知说服转向结构性干预,强调基于工作场所的服务提供、有针对性的空间资源分配以及保险改革,以减轻自付费用和机会成本。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是横断面的,这限制了因果推断,而且样本量虽然很大,但可能无法完全反映流动人口的多样性。由于三角测量方法,证据强度中等,但受到数据观察性质的限制。

papers.title: Evaluating the impact of the Hepatitis B Foundation's international storytelling program on empowerment, advocacy, and stigma reduction.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatitis B remains a major global public health challenge, characterized by low awareness, underdiagnosis, limited access to care, and persistent stigma. Storytelling has emerged as a promising health communication strategy to humanize disease experiences, reduce stigma, and promote advocacy. This study evaluates the Hepatitis B Foundation's International Storytelling Program and its impact on storytellers' empowerment, confidence, stigma experiences, and advocacy engagement. METHODS: A mixed-methods evaluation was conducted among adults who recorded personal hepatitis B stories through the program. Quantitative data were collected via an immediate post-recording survey (n = 25) and a follow-up survey 3-6 months later (n = 11), assessing satisfaction, emotional responses, confidence, stigma experiences, and advocacy activities. Survey instruments were developed by the study team and were not previously validated, which may limit measurement reliability and comparability across studies. Descriptive statistics were calculated. Fifteen participants were interviewed qualitatively; these individuals were part of an eligible pool of storytellers spanning 22 countries. Interviews were transcribed and analyzed using qualitative content analysis with double coding to support coding consistency. Quantitative and qualitative findings were integrated to provide a comprehensive understanding of program impacts. RESULTS: Participants reported high satisfaction and immediate personal benefits, including increased confidence (92%) and perceived preparedness to advocate (96%). At follow-up, participants reported increased comfort discussing hepatitis B (73%) and personal growth (73%), although findings should be interpreted cautiously due to the small sample size. Qualitative findings suggest that storytelling supported emotional processing, identity reframing, and increased willingness to disclose, while also contributing to perceived community awareness and engagement. CONCLUSIONS: The International Storytelling Program is a practical, promising approach for empowering individuals affected by hepatitis B and promoting advocacy and stigma reduction globally. However, results should be interpreted cautiously due to sample size and potential selection bias. Storytelling may serve as a complementary strategy to traditional public health approaches. TRIAL REGISTRATION: Not applicable.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review evaluates the Hepatitis B Foundation's International Storytelling Program, focusing on its impact on empowerment, advocacy, and stigma reduction among adults with hepatitis B across 22 countries. The central question examines whether storytelling as a health communication strategy can humanize disease experiences, reduce stigma, and promote advocacy engagement in this population.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review employs a mixed-methods evaluation of adults who recorded personal hepatitis B stories. Quantitative data were collected via an immediate post-recording survey (n=25) and a follow-up survey 3-6 months later (n=11), while qualitative interviews were conducted with 15 participants from 22 eligible countries. Survey instruments were developed by the study team and not previously validated, and descriptive statistics were calculated. Qualitative content analysis with double coding was used to ensure coding consistency.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Participants reported high immediate satisfaction and personal benefits, including increased confidence (92%) and perceived preparedness to advocate (96%). At follow-up, 73% reported increased comfort discussing hepatitis B and personal growth, though these findings are limited by small sample size. Qualitative findings indicate that storytelling supported emotional processing, identity reframing, increased willingness to disclose, and perceived community awareness and engagement.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The small sample size (n=25 immediate, n=11 follow-up) and potential selection bias limit the reliability and generalizability of quantitative findings. The lack of validated survey instruments may compromise measurement reliability and comparability across studies. The review does not address long-term sustainability of empowerment or advocacy outcomes beyond 3-6 months.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Future research should validate survey instruments and expand sample sizes to improve measurement reliability and generalizability. Longitudinal studies are needed to assess the durability of empowerment, advocacy, and stigma reduction outcomes. Program implementation should integrate validated tools to strengthen evidence of impact and inform public health strategies.

Descriptive statistics were calculated. Fifteen participants were interviewed qualitatively; these individuals were part of an eligible pool of storytellers spanning 22 countries. Interviews were transcribed and analyzed using qualitative content analysis with double coding to support coding consistency. Quantitative and qualitative findings were integrated to provide a comprehensive understanding of program impacts. RESULTS: Participants reported high satisfaction and immediate personal benefits, including increased confidence (92%) and perceived preparedness to advocate (96%). At follow-up, participants reported increased comfort discussing hepatitis B (73%) and personal growth (73%), although findings should be interpreted cautiously due to the small sample size. Qualitative findings suggest that storytelling supported emotional processing, identity reframing, and increased willingness to disclose, while also contributing to perceived community awareness and engagement. CONCLUSIONS: The International Storytelling Program is a practical, promising approach for empowering individuals affected by hepatitis B and promoting advocacy and stigma reduction globally. However, results should be interpreted cautiously due to sample size and potential selection bias. Storytelling may serve as a complementary strategy to traditional public health approaches. analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该审查评估了乙型肝炎基金会的国际讲故事计划,重点关注其对 22 个国家的成人乙型肝炎患者的赋权、宣传和减少耻辱的影响。核心问题是检验讲故事作为一种健康传播策略是否可以使疾病经历人性化、减少耻辱并促进该人群的宣传参与。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该审查对记录个人乙型肝炎故事的成年人采用了混合方法评估。通过立即记录后调查 (n=25) 和 3-6 个月后的跟踪调查 (n=11) 收集定量数据,同时对来自 22 个符合条件的国家的 15 名参与者进行定性访谈。调查工具由研究团队开发,之前未经验证,并计算了描述性统计数据。采用双重编码的定性内容分析来确保编码的一致性。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 参与者报告了很高的即时满意度和个人收益,包括信心增强 (92%) 和感知的倡导准备度 (96%)。在随访中,73% 的受访者表示,讨论乙型肝炎和个人成长时更加舒适,尽管这些发现受到样本量较小的限制。定性研究结果表明,讲故事支持情感处理、身份重构、增加披露意愿以及感知社区意识和参与度。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 小样本量(n=25 立即,n=11 后续)和潜在的选择偏差限制了定量研究结果的可靠性和普遍性。缺乏经过验证的调查工具可能会影响测量的可靠性和研究之间的可比性。该审查不涉及 3-6 个月以上的赋权或宣传成果的长期可持续性。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 未来的研究应该验证调查工具并扩大样本量,以提高测量的可靠性和普遍性。需要进行纵向研究来评估赋权、宣传和减少耻辱结果的持久性。计划实施应整合经过验证的工具,以加强影响证据并为公共卫生战略提供信息。

papers.title: Longitudinal Patterns of Chronic Hepatitis B Care and Treatment Adherence in Australia: A National Linked Data Cohort Study.
papers.abstract: Current uptake of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) treatment and care in Australia is well below target levels, leading to an ongoing burden of preventable liver disease and cancer. Understanding individual-level trajectories of care engagement and variation by sociodemographic factors is essential to guide efforts to improve access to and retention in care. This study analysed records of hepatitis B viral load (VL) testing and antiviral treatment provided through Australia's national health insurance system, which were linked to migration, death, and sociodemographic data from various government datasets. Treatment and VL testing by population group were assessed, and uptake was calculated using modelled estimates of the number living with CHB. VL testing frequency and treatment adherence based on scripts dispensed were also assessed. Of the estimated 219,800 people living with CHB in Australia in 2023, 118,334 (53.8%) received either VL testing or treatment during 2014-2023. Estimated uptake of VL testing and treatment uptake were lower among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and also varied by region of birth. Of the 81,360 who received any VL testing, only 17,352 (21.3%) received it regularly, while 31,715 (39.0%) had evidence of prior monitoring but no VL testing since 2019. The majority of those who initiated treatment continued therapy and received supply sufficient for adherence. This study shows that substantial gaps exist in CHB care in Australia, particularly in continued monitoring among those not on treatment. Disparities in uptake are evident by priority population. Re-engaging those lost to follow-up should be prioritised.

papers.title: Medication adherence in Chinese adults with chronic hepatitis B based on theory of planned behavior
papers.abstract: Purpose To investigate the factors related to medication adherence in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) infection by considering the theory of planned behavior (TPB). Methods In this cross-sectional study, medication adherence information was collected from outpatients with CHB in China. Pearson correlation analysis was performed to evaluate the association between medication adherence and TPB items. A structural equation model was established to further assess the effects of the latent TPB variables on medication adherence. Results A total of 225 patients with CHB recruited from the outpatient department of Qingdao Public Health Clinical Center were included, 67.6% of whom reported moderate medication adherence, as assessed using Morisky Adherence Assessment Score. Medication adherence was significantly positively correlated with behavioral intention ( r = 0.51, P < 0.001), perceived behavioral control ( r = 0.63, P < 0.001), and subjective norms ( r = 0.52, P < 0.001). Perceived behavioral control both directly and indirectly affected medication adherence, with the correlation coefficients being 0.14 and 0.32, respectively. The structural equation model revealed behavioral attitude and subjective norms as the strongest predictors of medication adherence, both of which indirectly affected behavior (correlation coefficients: 0.13 × 0.66 = 0.09 and 0.39 × 0.66 = 0.25, respectively). The optimal fitted model of TPB variables explained 58.5% of the variance in medication adherence. Conclusions Moderate medication adherence was discovered among Chinese adults with CHB. Behavioral attitude, subjective norms, and perceived behavioral control indirectly affected medication adherence.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的 结合计划行为理论(TPB)探讨慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)感染患者服药依从性的相关因素。方法 在这项横断面研究中,收集了中国慢性乙型肝炎门诊患者的用药依从性信息。进行 Pearson 相关分析来评估药物依从性和 TPB 项目之间的关联。建立结构方程模型以进一步评估潜在 TPB 变量对药物依从性的影响。结果 共纳入青岛市公共卫生临床中心门诊225例慢性乙型肝炎患者,采用Morisky依从性评估评分评估,其中67.6%的患者服药依从性中等。药物依从性与行为意向(r = 0.51,P < 0.001)、感知行为控制(r = 0.63,P < 0.001)和主观规范(r = 0.52,P < 0.001)呈显着正相关。感知行为控制直接和间接影响用药依从性,相关系数分别为0.14和0.32。结构方程模型显示,行为态度和主观规范是药物依从性最强的预测因素,两者都间接影响行为(相关系数:分别为 0.13 × 0.66 = 0.09 和 0.39 × 0.66 = 0.25)。TPB 变量的最佳拟合模型解释了药物依从性的 58.5% 的方差。结论 中国成人慢性乙型肝炎患者的药物依从性中等。行为态度、主观规范和感知行为控制间接影响药物依从性。

papers.full_text: Abstract Purpose of Review Long-term nucleos (t)ide analogue (NAs) treatment is usually required to maintain viral suppression in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB), with raising concerns on the long-term safety of NA therapy. In this review, we comprehensively summarized the current evidence on the long-term safety of NA therapy, with a particular focus on the first-line NAs (entecavir [ETV], tenofovir disoproxil fumarate [TDF], and tenofovir alafenamide [TAF]). Recent Findings The first-line NAs have no (TDF, TAF) or very low (ETV) viral resistance rates in treatment-naïve patients. ETV is associated with birth defects in animal studies. TDF is associated with a small risk renal and bone toxicity, primarily in older and higher risk patients. TAF has favorable renal and bone safety as compared to TDF, while its impact on lipid metabolism warrants attention. Although extremely rare, severe lactic acidosis can occur during NA treatment. Summary Long-term therapy with NAs is generally very safe, with potential risk of birth defects with ETV based on animal studies, potential viral resistance with ETV (rare if treatment-naïve and significant if prior lamivudine exposure/resistance), potential renal and bone mineral density adverse effects with TDF, lipid metabolism dysfunction with TAF, and rare but potentially severe lactic acidosis. Similar content being viewed by others Data Availability No datasets were generated or analysed during the current study. papers.title: HBcAg-Induced IL-17F drives liver fibrosis in occult HBV infection
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT While occult hepatitis B virus infection is a known risk factor for progressive liver diseases, the mechanistic basis for this association is poorly understood. To investigate this, we conducted a comparative study involving 40 OBI blood donors and 100 healthy blood donors to assess clinical parameters of liver fibrosis, including serum biomarkers, the FIB-4 index, and liver stiffness measurement. Transcriptome sequencing of peripheral blood mononuclear cells from these donors identified IL-17F as significantly upregulated in the OBI group. Mechanistically, we found that IL-17F was chiefly secreted by CD4 + T cells upon HBcAg stimulation and functionally promoted the expression of key fibrosis-related cytokines and markers. Collectively, our study unveils a novel pathway wherein HBcAg induces CD4 + T cells to secrete IL-17F, which in turn accelerates liver fibrogenesis, providing a mechanistic basis for OBI-associated liver disease. IMPORTANCE This study reveals, for the first time, a novel mechanism by which OBI drives liver fibrosis, demonstrating that HBcAg stimulates CD4 + T cells to secrete IL-17F, which in turn activates macrophages and hepatic stellate cells, thereby promoting liver inflammation and fibrosis. This discovery not only elucidates a key molecular pathway underlying OBI-related liver disease progression, but also provides an important theoretical foundation for developing IL-17F-targeted diagnostic approaches and anti-fibrotic therapies.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Occult hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is associated with progressive liver diseases, but the mechanistic basis remains unclear. The study aimed to elucidate how occult HBV infection contributes to liver fibrosis.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A comparative study was conducted involving 40 occult HBV infection (OBI) blood donors and 100 healthy blood donors to evaluate liver fibrosis parameters. The study assessed clinical markers including serum biomarkers, the FIB-4 index, and liver stiffness measurement.
analysis.methods: Transcriptome sequencing of peripheral blood mononuclear cells identified IL-17F as upregulated in the OBI group. Mechanistic experiments demonstrated that IL-17F was primarily secreted by CD4+ T cells upon HBcAg stimulation and promoted fibrosis-related cytokine and marker expression.
analysis.main_results: IL-17F was chiefly secreted by CD4+ T cells following HBcAg stimulation and functionally enhanced the expression of fibrosis-related cytokines and markers.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study reveals a novel pathway in which HBcAg induces CD4+ T cells to secrete IL-17F, which accelerates liver fibrogenesis, providing a mechanistic basis for OBI-associated liver disease.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest potential targets for IL-17F-based diagnostic approaches and anti-fibrotic therapies in OBI-related liver disease.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to the abstract and lacks detailed methodological, statistical, or validation data, warranting cautious interpretation of the mechanistic pathway and its clinical implications.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the mechanistic basis of liver fibrosis in occult HBV infection (OBI) by comparing 40 OBI blood donors with 100 healthy controls. Transcriptome sequencing identified IL-17F as upregulated in OBI donors, and mechanistic experiments showed that IL-17F was secreted by CD4+ T cells upon HBcAg stimulation, promoting fibrosis-related cytokine expression. The authors propose a novel pathway where HBcAg drives IL-17F-mediated liver fibrogenesis, offering a potential mechanistic explanation for OBI-associated liver disease. The findings suggest IL-17F as a target for diagnostic and therapeutic strategies, though the evidence is confined to the abstract and lacks detailed validation.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对 40 名隐匿性 HBV 感染 (OBI) 献血者和 100 名健康献血者进行了一项比较研究,以评估肝纤维化参数。该研究评估了临床标志物,包括血清生物标志物、FIB-4 指数和肝脏硬度测量。

elements_zh.main_results: IL-17F 主要由 HBcAg 刺激后的 CD4+ T 细胞分泌,并在功能上增强纤维化相关细胞因子和标志物的表达。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究揭示了 HBcAg 诱导 CD4+ T 细胞分泌 IL-17F 的新途径,从而加速肝纤维化,为 OBI 相关肝病提供了机制基础。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,基于 IL-17F 的诊断方法和抗纤维化治疗 OBI 相关肝病的潜在靶点。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于摘要,缺乏详细的方法学、统计或验证数据,需要对机制途径及其临床意义进行谨慎解释。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 虽然隐匿性乙型肝炎病毒感染是进行性肝病的已知危险因素,但人们对这种关联的机制基础知之甚少。为了调查这一点,我们进行了一项比较研究,涉及 40 名 OBI 献血者和 100 名健康献血者,以评估肝纤维化的临床参数,包括血清生物标志物、FIB-4 指数和肝脏硬度测量。对这些供体的外周血单核细胞进行转录组测序,发现 OBI 组中 IL-17F 显着上调。从机制上讲,我们发现 IL-17F 主要由 CD4 + T 细胞在 HBcAg 刺激后分泌,并在功能上促进关键纤维化相关细胞因子和标志物的表达。总的来说,我们的研究揭示了一种新途径,其中 HBcAg 诱导 CD4 + T 细胞分泌 IL-17F,进而加速肝纤维形成,为 OBI 相关肝病提供机制基础。重要性 这项研究首次揭示了 OBI 驱动肝纤维化的新机制,证明 HBcAg 刺激 CD4+T 细胞分泌 IL-17F,进而激活巨噬细胞和肝星状细胞,从而促进肝脏炎症和纤维化。这一发现不仅阐明了OBI相关肝病进展的关键分子通路,而且为开发IL-17F靶向诊断方法和抗纤维化治疗提供了重要的理论基础。

papers.title: High Rates of Advanced Chronic Liver Disease in Patients With Chronic Hepatitis D Virus Infection in Uzbekistan
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background and Aims Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is endemic in Uzbekistan. Previous data showed a high prevalence of anti‐hepatitis D virus (HDV) antibodies in HBsAg‐positive individuals. Limited data are available on disease severity, treatment availability and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) prevalence in patients with chronic HDV infection in Uzbekistan. Methods The Scientific Research Institute of Virology (SRIoV) is the leading medical and scientific reference centre for viral hepatitis in Uzbekistan. In this retrospective study, epidemiological, clinical and laboratory data were collected and analysed from all HBsAg‐positive patients presenting to the SRIoV between June 2023 and May 2024. Data from HDV‐coinfected and HBV‐monoinfected patients were compared. Results Data of 1393 individual patients were included. HDV coinfection was more prevalent than HBV‐monoinfection (73.9% [ n = 1030/1393]) vs. 26.1% [ n = 363/1393]. HDV‐infected patients were significantly younger (41.9 vs. 45.4, p p n = 4/1030). Consecutively, HDV RNA was detectable in 78.9% (812/1023) of patients. Quantitative HDV RNA was independently associated with ALT elevation > upper limit of normal. The HCC detection rate was low in both patient groups due to insufficient screening measures (HDV: n = 7/1030, HBV: n = 11/363). Conclusions In this retrospective cohort of 1393 individual patients, HDV coinfection exceeds HBV monoinfection in prevalence and disease severity. Most HDV‐infected patients present with advanced liver disease and currently lack access to HDV‐directed therapy.

papers.title: Chronic HBV Infection Disrupts CCL5‐Secreting cNK Cells and Attenuates Liver Accumulation and Activation of DCs and HBV‐Specific T Cells
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Understanding the immunological mechanisms underlying chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection‐induced immune tolerance is critical for developing effective therapeutic strategies, yet the mechanisms by which natural killer (NK)‐cell subsets regulate dendritic cell (DC)‐mediated antiviral immunity during chronic HBV infection remain unclear. Here, we demonstrated that chronic HBV infection disrupted intrahepatic DCs accumulation and activation by suppressing CC chemokine ligand 5 (CCL5) production from hepatic NK cells. Importantly, chronic HBV infection reduced the number of hepatic conventional NK (cNK) cells, the main source of hepatic CCL5, whereas liver‐resident NK (LrNK) cells increased and exhibited lower CCL5 expression and immunosuppressive features. Adoptive transfer of CCL5‐competent hepatic cNK cells promoted DCs accumulation and activation, enhanced HBV‐specific CD8 + T‐cell responses, and facilitated viral clearance. Mechanistically, chronic HBV infection promoted the activation of adenosine A2a receptor (ADORA2A)/nuclear factor kappa‐B (NF‐κB) pathway in hepatic NK cells, thereby antagonizing NF‐κB activation, reducing the proportion of cNK cells, suppressing CCL5 production, and ultimately impairing hepatic aggregation and activation of DCs, leading to defective anti‐HBV immune responses. This study revealed a novel mechanism involved in chronic HBV infection‐induced immune tolerance and indicated that targeting the ADORA2A/NFκB/CCL5 axis in cNK cells may represent a potential therapeutic strategy for chronic HBV infection.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 摘要:了解慢性乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染引起的免疫耐受的免疫机制对于制定有效的治疗策略至关重要,但自然杀伤 (NK) 细胞亚群在慢性 HBV 感染期间调节树突状细胞 (DC) 介导的抗病毒免疫的机制仍不清楚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项研究揭示了慢性 HBV 感染诱导的免疫耐受的新机制,并表明靶向 cNK 细胞中的 ADORA2A/NFκB/CCL5 轴可能代表慢性 HBV 感染的潜在治疗策略。
elements_zh.methods: 所提供的证据没有明确说明核心实验、分析或统计方法。
elements_zh.main_results: 重要的是,慢性 HBV 感染减少了肝脏常规 NK (cNK) 细胞(肝脏 CCL5 的主要来源)的数量,而肝脏驻留 NK (LrNK) 细胞增加并表现出较低的 CCL5 表达和免疫抑制特征。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在这里,我们证明慢性 HBV 感染通过抑制肝 NK 细胞产生 CC 趋化因子配体 5 (CCL5) 来破坏肝内 DC 的积累和激活。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 从机制上讲,慢性HBV感染促进肝NK细胞中腺苷A2a受体(ADORA2A)/核因子κB(NF-κB)通路的激活,从而拮抗NF-κB激活,降低cNK细胞比例,抑制CCL5产生,最终损害肝脏聚集和DCs激活,导致抗HBV免疫反应缺陷。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: CCL5 活性肝 cNK 细胞的过继转移促进了 DC 的积累和激活,增强了 HBV 特异性 CD8 + T 细胞反应,并促进了病毒清除。

papers.title: NGS-diagnosed HBV encephalitis with isolated left parietal lobe involvement: a case report
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Viral encephalitis refers to the inflammation of the brain parenchyma caused by viral infection, usually manifested as fever, unconsciousness, seizures, and meningeal irritation symptoms. The non-specific clinical manifestations, combined with incomplete medical history, often lead to missed diagnoses and inappropriate treatments. Case presentation We present a case of Hepatitis B virus (HBV) encephalitis, manifesting as isolated left parietal lobe involvement. The patient is a chronic hepatitis B virus carrier who did not receive antiviral therapy. Upon onset, the main symptoms were unconsciousness, fever, and seizures. He was diagnosed with HBV encephalitis thru next-generation sequencing (NGS) testing of the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). After antiviral treatment with entecavir and general symptomatic treatment, the patient’s clinical symptoms disappeared, and a follow-up brain MRI showed that the lesion had almost completely resolved. Conclusions Central nervous system (CNS) infections caused by HBV are incredibly uncommon in clinical practice. This case highlights that the clinical manifestations of HBV encephalitis are nonspecific and prone to being missed, while neuroimaging often reveals an isolated lesion. Early application of NGS for accurate pathogen diagnosis is crucial to reduce misdiagnosis.

source_records.abstract: BACKGROUND: Viral encephalitis refers to the inflammation of the brain parenchyma caused by viral infection, usually manifested as fever, unconsciousness, seizures, and meningeal irritation symptoms. The non-specific clinical manifestations, combined with incomplete medical history, often lead to missed diagnoses and inappropriate treatments. CASE PRESENTATION: We present a case of Hepatitis B virus (HBV) encephalitis, manifesting as isolated left parietal lobe involvement. The patient is a chronic hepatitis B virus carrier who did not receive antiviral therapy. Upon onset, the main symptoms were unconsciousness, fever, and seizures. He was diagnosed with HBV encephalitis thru next-generation sequencing (NGS) testing of the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). After antiviral treatment with entecavir and general symptomatic treatment, the patient's clinical symptoms disappeared, and a follow-up brain MRI showed that the lesion had almost completely resolved. CONCLUSIONS: Central nervous system (CNS) infections caused by HBV are incredibly uncommon in clinical practice. This case highlights that the clinical manifestations of HBV encephalitis are nonspecific and prone to being missed, while neuroimaging often reveals an isolated lesion. Early application of NGS for accurate pathogen diagnosis is crucial to reduce misdiagnosis.

papers.title: Itaconic acid alleviates acute hepatitis by reprogramming NK cell metabolism with mitochondrial dysfunction
papers.abstract:
Background

Immunometabolism provides critical insights into the pathogenesis and treatment of inflammatory diseases. Itaconic acid (ITA), a key immunomodulatory metabolite derived from the tricarboxylic acid cycle, has been extensively characterized in macrophages; however, its direct effects on NK cells and NK cell-mediated liver pathology remain poorly defined.

Methods

Using SCENITH and Seahorse analyses, we assessed ITA's impact on NK cell metabolism via multi-omics, and investigated its underlying mechanisms. The therapeutic potential was then evaluated in a mouse model of poly (I:C)-induced liver injury.

Results

We show that ITA reprograms NK cell metabolism to suppress their proliferation and killing capacity, simultaneously suppressing oxidative phosphorylation while inducing a compensatory glycolytic shift. Multi-omics integration revealed that this metabolic shift corresponds with the upregulation of glycolytic gene networks and significant mitochondrial impairment, mechanistically linked to the inhibition of succinate dehydrogenase (SDH) activity and the downregulation of the NRF1/TFAM mitochondrial biogenesis pathway. ITA also damages mitochondria and impairs autophagic activity, resulting in accumulation of dysfunctional mitochondria in NK cells. All these alterations lead to profound suppression of NK cell proliferation and cytotoxic function. Administration of ITA in mice with poly (I:C) -induced liver injury substantially attenuated hepatic damage and suppressed over-inflammation in the liver. This protective effect was associated with inhibited hepatic infiltration and function of both NK and T cells.

Conclusion

Our findings extend the understanding of the immune regulation and metabolic reprogramming of ITA to NK cells, showing that ITA inhibits SDH activity to down-regulate mitochondrial biogenesis through NRF1/TFAM in NK cells with consequent limitation of cytotoxic function, suggesting the further therapeutic potential of ITA application in NK cells-mediated liver pathologies.

方法

使用 SCENITH 和 Seahorse 分析,我们通过多组学评估了 ITA 对 NK 细胞代谢的影响,并研究了其潜在机制。

然后在多聚 (I:C) 诱导的肝损伤小鼠模型中评估其治疗潜力。

结果

我们表明,ITA 重新编程 NK 细胞代谢,抑制其增殖和杀伤能力,同时抑制氧化磷酸化,同时诱导补偿性糖酵解转变。

这种保护作用与抑制 NK 和 T 细胞的肝脏浸润和功能有关。

结论

我们的研究结果扩展了对 ITA 对 NK 细胞的免疫调节和代谢重编程的理解,表明 ITA 抑制 SDH 活性,通过 NK 细胞中的 NRF1/TFAM 下调线粒体生物合成,从而限制细胞毒功能,这表明 ITA 在 NK 细胞介导的肝脏病理中的应用具有进一步的治疗潜力。

papers.title_zh: 衣康酸通过重新编程线粒体功能障碍的 NK 细胞代谢来缓解急性肝炎
papers.source_body_en:
Background

Immunometabolism provides critical insights into the pathogenesis and treatment of inflammatory diseases. Itaconic acid (ITA), a key immunomodulatory metabolite derived from the tricarboxylic acid cycle, has been extensively characterized in macrophages; however, its direct effects on NK cells and NK cell-mediated liver pathology remain poorly defined.

Methods

Using SCENITH and Seahorse analyses, we assessed ITA's impact on NK cell metabolism via multi-omics, and investigated its underlying mechanisms. The therapeutic potential was then evaluated in a mouse model of poly (I:C)-induced liver injury.

Results

We show that ITA reprograms NK cell metabolism to suppress their proliferation and killing capacity, simultaneously suppressing oxidative phosphorylation while inducing a compensatory glycolytic shift. Multi-omics integration revealed that this metabolic shift corresponds with the upregulation of glycolytic gene networks and significant mitochondrial impairment, mechanistically linked to the inhibition of succinate dehydrogenase (SDH) activity and the downregulation of the NRF1/TFAM mitochondrial biogenesis pathway. ITA also damages mitochondria and impairs autophagic activity, resulting in accumulation of dysfunctional mitochondria in NK cells. All these alterations lead to profound suppression of NK cell proliferation and cytotoxic function. Administration of ITA in mice with poly (I:C) -induced liver injury substantially attenuated hepatic damage and suppressed over-inflammation in the liver. This protective effect was associated with inhibited hepatic infiltration and function of both NK and T cells.

Conclusion

Our findings extend the understanding of the immune regulation and metabolic reprogramming of ITA to NK cells, showing that ITA inhibits SDH activity to down-regulate mitochondrial biogenesis through NRF1/TFAM in NK cells with consequent limitation of cytotoxic function, suggesting the further therapeutic potential of ITA application in NK cells-mediated liver pathologies.
papers.abstract_zh:
背景

免疫代谢为炎症性疾病的发病机制和治疗提供了重要的见解。衣康酸 (ITA) 是一种源自三羧酸循环的关键免疫调节代谢物,已在巨噬细胞中得到广泛表征;然而,其对 NK 细胞和 NK 细胞介导的肝脏病理学的直接影响仍不清楚。

方法

使用 SCENITH 和 Seahorse 分析,我们通过多组学评估了 ITA 对 NK 细胞代谢的影响,并研究了其潜在机制。然后在多聚 (I:C) 诱导的肝损伤小鼠模型中评估其治疗潜力。

结果

我们表明,ITA 重新编程 NK 细胞代谢,抑制其增殖和杀伤能力,同时抑制氧化磷酸化,同时诱导补偿性糖酵解转变。多组学整合表明,这种代谢变化与糖酵解基因网络的上调和显着的线粒体损伤相对应,在机制上与琥珀酸脱氢酶(SDH)活性的抑制和 NRF1/TFAM 线粒体生物发生途径的下调有关。ITA 还会损害线粒体并损害自噬活性,导致 NK 细胞中功能失调的线粒体积聚。所有这些改变都会导致 NK 细胞增殖和细胞毒功能受到严重抑制。对患有聚(I:C)诱导的肝损伤的小鼠施用ITA可显着减轻肝损伤并抑制肝脏的过度炎症。这种保护作用与抑制 NK 和 T 细胞的肝脏浸润和功能有关。

结论

我们的研究结果扩展了对 ITA 对 NK 细胞的免疫调节和代谢重编程的理解,表明 ITA 抑制 SDH 活性,通过 NK 细胞中的 NRF1/TFAM 下调线粒体生物合成,从而限制细胞毒功能,这表明 ITA 在 NK 细胞介导的肝脏病理中的应用具有进一步的治疗潜力。

papers.title: Supramolecular Self-Assembly of Lycorine with Glycyrrhizic Acid into a Nanodrug for Safe and Sustained Anti-HBV Therapy
papers.abstract: Achieving a functional cure for chronic hepatitis B remains a major challenge, as conventional therapies struggle to eliminate the hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) and subsequently restore adaptive antiviral immunity. Lycorine (LY), a compound with broad-spectrum antiviral activity, has shown particular promise inhibiting HBsAg secretion. However, its clinical application is severely limited by significant cytotoxicity, the induction of apoptosis, a short half-life, and adverse in vivo effects. To overcome these barriers and enhance its therapeutic potential, we designed a self-assembled nanomedicine (LGN) by co-assembling LY with glycyrrhizic acid, a natural anti-HBV agent. This strategy not only protected LY from premature degradation and enabled its sustained release in the colon but also markedly attenuated LY-induced systemic toxicity. Notably, LGN effectively suppressed HBsAg secretion (IC50 = 2.15 ± 0.09 μM) with a selectivity index (SI > 93) over two-fold higher than that of LY alone (SI = 39.26). Furthermore, LGN concurrently inhibited HBV DNA replication, pgRNA transcription, and the expression of viral protein HBc and HBx, indicating a multitargeted, host-dependent mechanism distinct from nucleos(t)ide analogs. Treatment with this nanomedicine in the HDI model further demonstrated its therapeutic potential against HBV with apparent safety. Further transcriptomic study confirmed that LGN induces a distinct host transcriptional program that disrupts multiple critical stages of the HBV life cycle including viral entry, covalently closed circular DNA maintenance, gene transcription, and immune evasion. Collectively, these findings provide valuable insights into exploiting natural products like LY for antiviral therapy and underscore the potential of self-assembly technology in improving drug safety and pharmacokinetic profiles.

papers.title: B/F/TAF in people with both HIV-1 and hepatitis B: outcomes from the ALLIANCE open-label extension phase.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Data on bictegravir/emtricitabine/tenofovir alafenamide (B/F/TAF) in people with both HIV-1 and HBV are limited, particularly for treatment-experienced people. METHODS: ALLIANCE was a randomized, double-blind, active-controlled, phase 3 study of B/F/TAF versus dolutegravir (DTG) + emtricitabine/tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (F/TDF) in treatment-naïve adults with HIV-1 RNA ≥ 500 copies/mL and HBV DNA ≥ 2000 IU/mL. Participants received continuous B/F/TAF through 144 weeks (≥ 96 weeks of blinded treatment plus 48-week optional open-label extension [OLE]) or switched to B/F/TAF after ≥ 96 weeks of DTG + F/TDF through 48 weeks of OLE. Here we report outcomes from the OLE. RESULTS: 121 participants were included in the continuous B/F/TAF group; 89 in the switch group. Median B/F/TAF exposure was 186.4 and 48 weeks, respectively. HIV-1 and HBV suppression rates (missing = excluded) were maintained in both groups (B/F/TAF Week 144: 99.0% and 80.2%; switch OLE Week 48: 95.4% and 86.6%, respectively). Both groups had improved alanine aminotransferase normalization. HBV envelope antigen loss and seroconversion occurred in 44.8% and 29.3%, respectively, of participants receiving continuous B/F/TAF (Week 144) and 17.0% and 12.8% in the switch group (OLE Week 48). HBV surface antigen loss and seroconversion occurred in 22.5% and 15.5% (continuous B/F/TAF), and 4.3% and 0% (switch group) of participants, respectively. One participant (continuous B/F/TAF) discontinued due to study drug-unrelated treatment-emergent adverse event. No treatment-emergent resistance was reported. CONCLUSION: B/F/TAF was effective in HIV-1 and HBV suppression and well tolerated in treatment-naïve individuals for ≤ 3 years and ≤ 1 year after switching from a TDF-based regimen. Trial registration ClinicalTrials.gov NCT03547908 (first registration 2018-05-24).

papers.title_zh: HIV-1 和乙型肝炎患者的 B/F/TAF:ALLIANCE 开放标签扩展阶段的结果。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Data on bictegravir/emtricitabine/tenofovir alafenamide (B/F/TAF) in people with both HIV-1 and HBV are limited, particularly for treatment-experienced people. METHODS: ALLIANCE was a randomized, double-blind, active-controlled, phase 3 study of B/F/TAF versus dolutegravir (DTG) + emtricitabine/tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (F/TDF) in treatment-naïve adults with HIV-1 RNA ≥ 500 copies/mL and HBV DNA ≥ 2000 IU/mL. Participants received continuous B/F/TAF through 144 weeks (≥ 96 weeks of blinded treatment plus 48-week optional open-label extension [OLE]) or switched to B/F/TAF after ≥ 96 weeks of DTG + F/TDF through 48 weeks of OLE. Here we report outcomes from the OLE. RESULTS: 121 participants were included in the continuous B/F/TAF group; 89 in the switch group. Median B/F/TAF exposure was 186.4 and 48 weeks, respectively. HIV-1 and HBV suppression rates (missing = excluded) were maintained in both groups (B/F/TAF Week 144: 99.0% and 80.2%; switch OLE Week 48: 95.4% and 86.6%, respectively). Both groups had improved alanine aminotransferase normalization. HBV envelope antigen loss and seroconversion occurred in 44.8% and 29.3%, respectively, of participants receiving continuous B/F/TAF (Week 144) and 17.0% and 12.8% in the switch group (OLE Week 48). HBV surface antigen loss and seroconversion occurred in 22.5% and 15.5% (continuous B/F/TAF), and 4.3% and 0% (switch group) of participants, respectively. One participant (continuous B/F/TAF) discontinued due to study drug-unrelated treatment-emergent adverse event. No treatment-emergent resistance was reported. CONCLUSION: B/F/TAF was effective in HIV-1 and HBV suppression and well tolerated in treatment-naïve individuals for ≤ 3 years and ≤ 1 year after switching from a TDF-based regimen. Trial registration ClinicalTrials.gov NCT03547908 (first registration 2018-05-24).

papers.title: AURKA regulates HBV-induced hepatic stellate cell inflammation and liver fibrosis by modulating K48-linked ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation of TLR3
papers.abstract: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB), caused by persistent hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection, continues to pose a major global health threat. Aurora kinase A (AURKA) has been implicated in fibrosis, yet its role in HBV-induced liver fibrosis remains unclear. This study investigated the function and mechanism of AURKA in hepatic stellate cell (HSC) activation and fibrogenesis during CHB. Bioinformatics screening of GSE83148 dataset and validation in human CHB liver specimens, LX-2 HSCs treated with conditioned medium (CM) from HBV-replicating cells, and a persistent HBV recombinant cccDNA (rcccDNA) mouse model established by tail-vein injection of Ad/rcccDNA were performed. Gene and protein expression was analyzed by quantitative PCR and immunoblotting, respectively. Cytokine levels were measured by ELISA. Mitochondrial function was assessed via ROS and JC-1 assays. Protein interactions and ubiquitination were evaluated by co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP) and protein stability assays. In additional experiments, LX-2 cells were stimulated with purified HBV virions at varying MOIs to assess direct viral effects. AURKA was significantly upregulated in CHB patients and HBV-CM-treated LX-2 HSCs. In LX-2 HSCs, AURKA knockdown attenuated HBV-CM-induced inflammatory cytokine secretion (IL‐1β, IL‐6), mitochondrial dysfunction (mitochondrial ROS, mitochondrial membrane potential), HSC proliferation, and fibrotic marker expression (COL I, α-SMA). Mechanistically, AURKA interacted with TLR3 and was associated with its K48-linked polyubiquitination and degradation. TLR3 silencing abolished the protective effects of AURKA knockdown. In vivo, using a persistent HBV rcccDNA mouse model, AURKA knockdown ameliorated HBV-induced hepatic inflammation and fibrosis by upregulating TLR3. Notably, purified HBV virions alone were sufficient to dose-dependently induce AURKA expression and downstream fibrotic responses in HSCs. This study identifies a novel AURKA/TLR3 axis that regulates HBV-induced HSC activation and liver fibrosis, positioning AURKA as a potential therapeutic target for CHB-associated fibrosis.

papers.abstract_zh: 由持续乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染引起的慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)继续对全球健康构成重大威胁。极光激酶 A (AURKA) 与纤维化有关,但其在 HBV 诱导的肝纤维化中的作用仍不清楚。本研究探讨了 AURKA 在 CHB 期间肝星状细胞 (HSC) 激活和纤维形成中的功能和机制。对 GSE83148 数据集进行生物信息学筛选,并在人 CHB 肝脏标本、用来自 HBV 复制细胞的条件培养基 (CM) 处理的 LX-2 HSC 以及通过尾静脉注射 Ad/rcccDNA 建立的持久性 HBV 重组 cccDNA (rcccDNA) 小鼠模型中进行验证。分别通过定量PCR和免疫印迹分析基因和蛋白质表达。通过ELISA测量细胞因子水平。通过 ROS 和 JC-1 测定评估线粒体功能。通过免疫共沉淀 (Co-IP) 和蛋白质稳定性测定评估蛋白质相互作用和泛素化。在其他实验中,用纯化的 HBV 病毒粒子以不同的 MOI 刺激 LX-2 细胞,以评估直接病毒效应。AURKA 在 CHB 患者和 HBV-CM 治疗的 LX-2 HSC 中显着上调。在 LX-2 HSC 中,AURKA 敲低减弱了 HBV-CM 诱导的炎症细胞因子分泌(IL-1β、IL-6)、线粒体功能障碍(线粒体 ROS、线粒体膜电位)、HSC 增殖和纤维化标志物表达(COL I、α-SMA)。从机制上讲,AURKA 与 TLR3 相互作用,并与其 K48 连接的多聚泛素化和降解相关。TLR3 沉默消除了 AURKA 敲低的保护作用。在体内,使用持续性 HBV rcccDNA 小鼠模型,AURKA 敲低通过上调 TLR3 改善 HBV 诱导的肝脏炎症和纤维化。值得注意的是,单独纯化的 HBV 病毒体足以剂量依赖性地诱导 HSC 中的 AURKA 表达和下游纤维化反应。这项研究确定了一个新的 AURKA/TLR3 轴,可以调节 HBV 诱导的 HSC 激活和肝纤维化,将 AURKA 定位为 CHB 相关纤维化的潜在治疗靶点。

papers.title: Programmable Nanobody‐Targeting Chimeras Enable Intracellular Viral Protein Degradation
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major global health challenge, largely because current antiviral therapies seldom achieve sustained clearance of the viral surface antigen (HBsAg), a central driver of immune tolerance and viral persistence. Here, we present a programmable, nanobody‐based targeted protein degradation platform, termed Nanobody‐Targeting Chimera (Nab‐TAC), designed for the intracellular clearance of HBV antigens. To systematically identify functional degradation modules, we developed a split‐luciferase complementation‐based quantitative screening platform that benchmarks degron motifs and proximity‐inducing effectors, enabling comprehensive ranking of proteasome‐ and lysosome‐targeting elements across diverse cellular contexts and subcellular compartments. By coupling phage display‐derived nanobodies and single‐chain variable fragments with these optimized degradation modules, we engineered a panel of Nab‐TAC constructs that efficiently degrade viral HBsAg in hepatocytes. Notably, the lead construct, E3‐FCGR3B, achieved robust intrahepatic antigen clearance and markedly reduced circulating HBsAg levels in an HBV hydrodynamic injection mouse model. Together, these findings establish Nab‐TAC as a modular and versatile platform for targeted antiviral protein degradation and highlight its potential as a therapeutic strategy toward a functional cure for chronic HBV infection.

By coupling phage display‐derived nanobodies and single‐chain variable fragments with these optimized degradation modules, we engineered a panel of Nab‐TAC constructs that efficiently degrade viral HBsAg in hepatocytes. Notably, the lead construct, E3‐FCGR3B, achieved robust intrahepatic antigen clearance and markedly reduced circulating HBsAg levels in an HBV hydrodynamic injection mouse model. Together, these findings establish Nab‐TAC as a modular and versatile platform for targeted antiviral protein degradation and highlight its potential as a therapeutic strategy toward a functional cure for chronic HBV infection.

papers.title: Viral Hepatitis B in the Kyrgyz Republic: Epidemiological Trends and the Role of Vaccination (Literature Review)
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major public health problem in the Kyrgyz Republic, contributing significantly to the burden of chronic liver diseases, including cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. The aim of this study was to assess the epidemiological trends of HBV infection and evaluate the impact of vaccination on disease patterns. A systematic review of scientific publications (2015–2023), WHO reports, and national regulatory documents was conducted. The results demonstrate that the introduction of neonatal vaccination has led to a substantial decline in acute HBV incidence and the near elimination of infection among children. However, a high prevalence of chronic HBV persists among adults, particularly in cohorts born before the implementation of universal immunization. Regional disparities in vaccination coverage and incomplete vaccination schedules were also identified. The current epidemiological pattern is characterized by a shift of the disease burden toward adult populations. Achieving WHO elimination targets by 2030 requires the expansion of adult vaccination programs, strengthening epidemiological surveillance, and the integration of vaccination and disease monitoring systems.

papers.title: Safety and efficacy of libevitug in patients with chronic hepatitis B and D virus coinfection: A single-center, open-label, phase IIa trial in China
papers.abstract: Background: Chronic HBV and HDV coinfection represents the most severe form of viral hepatitis. This study aimed to assess the safety and efficacy of libevitug (HH-003), a novel human monoclonal antibody targeting the PreS1 domain of the HBV large envelope protein, in patients with chronic HBV and HDV coinfection. Methods: This single-center, open-label, proof-of-concept phase IIa clinical trial enrolled 9 participants who received i.v. infusion of 20 mg/kg libevitug every 2 weeks for 24 weeks, followed by a 24-week follow-up period. Results: At week 24, 8 participants (88.9%) exhibited a reduction in HDV RNA ≥1 log 10 from baseline, with 4 (44.4%) achieving undetectable levels. 7 participants (77.8%) achieved virological response (undetectable HDV RNA or ≥2 log 10 decline from baseline). Among the 5 participants with elevated baseline ALT, 3 (60.0%) achieved a combined virological and biochemical response (ALT normalization). At week 48, 6 participants (66.7%) maintained the virological response achieved at the end of treatment (week 24), with 3 (33.3%) maintaining undetectable HDV RNA levels. Among the 7 participants with quantifiable HBV DNA at baseline, 2 (28.6%) achieved undetectable HBV DNA or ≥1 log 10 reduction at week 24. Serum HBsAg levels remained unchanged throughout the study period. Treatment-emergent adverse events were reported in 8 participants (88.9%), with only 1 participant (11.1%) experiencing treatment-related adverse events. No grade 3 or serious adverse events were reported, and no discontinuations due to adverse events occurred. Conclusions: Libevitug demonstrated promising antiviral activity, achieving substantial HDV RNA reduction, a high rate of ALT normalization, and favorable safety and tolerability in participants with chronic HBV and HDV coinfection.

papers.title_zh: libevitug 在慢性乙型肝炎和丁型肝炎病毒合并感染患者中的安全性和有效性:中国的单中心、开放标签、IIa 期试验
papers.source_body_en: Background: Chronic HBV and HDV coinfection represents the most severe form of viral hepatitis. This study aimed to assess the safety and efficacy of libevitug (HH-003), a novel human monoclonal antibody targeting the PreS1 domain of the HBV large envelope protein, in patients with chronic HBV and HDV coinfection. Methods: This single-center, open-label, proof-of-concept phase IIa clinical trial enrolled 9 participants who received i.v. infusion of 20 mg/kg libevitug every 2 weeks for 24 weeks, followed by a 24-week follow-up period. Results: At week 24, 8 participants (88.9%) exhibited a reduction in HDV RNA ≥1 log 10 from baseline, with 4 (44.4%) achieving undetectable levels. 7 participants (77.8%) achieved virological response (undetectable HDV RNA or ≥2 log 10 decline from baseline). Among the 5 participants with elevated baseline ALT, 3 (60.0%) achieved a combined virological and biochemical response (ALT normalization). At week 48, 6 participants (66.7%) maintained the virological response achieved at the end of treatment (week 24), with 3 (33.3%) maintaining undetectable HDV RNA levels. Among the 7 participants with quantifiable HBV DNA at baseline, 2 (28.6%) achieved undetectable HBV DNA or ≥1 log 10 reduction at week 24. Serum HBsAg levels remained unchanged throughout the study period. Treatment-emergent adverse events were reported in 8 participants (88.9%), with only 1 participant (11.1%) experiencing treatment-related adverse events. No grade 3 or serious adverse events were reported, and no discontinuations due to adverse events occurred. Conclusions: Libevitug demonstrated promising antiviral activity, achieving substantial HDV RNA reduction, a high rate of ALT normalization, and favorable safety and tolerability in participants with chronic HBV and HDV coinfection.

papers.title: Enhanced surveillance for hepatitis B and C: insights into clinical care after diagnosis
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: There are known gaps in care uptake for hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection, and public health surveillance represents an opportunity to support health service engagement for cases; however, specific data are lacking regarding follow-up after diagnosis. We assessed outcomes of a Victorian initiative to enhance data availability and to support linkage to care. METHODS: Notified cases of HBV and HCV within Victoria during 2023-2024 were analysed to determine post-diagnosis follow-up, including variation by demographics and setting, and reported reasons for lack of linkage to care. RESULTS: Information was available for two-thirds of cases. For HBV, 37.7% reported current treatment or management, while 53.6% reported referral or assessment in progress; for HCV, these proportions were 33.3% and 54.7%. Reasons for gaps included loss to follow-up, cost barriers, and misapplication of HBV treatment criteria. DISCUSSION: Cascade of care information can be effectively collected via public health surveillance, and these systems represent an opportunity to support prioritisation of public health follow-up.

papers.title: Surveillance of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) patients using Protein Induced by Vitamin K (PIVKA-II): A cost-utility analysis for Hong Kong
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND & AIMS: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a leading cause of cancer-related death in Hong Kong. Common risk factors include chronic hepatitis B (CHB) infection and/ or liver cirrhosis (LC). Routine HCC surveillance using ultrasound plus alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) for patients with these conditions is recommended, but many patients still face limited access to ultrasound. For these, biomarker-based surveillance using a combination of protein induced by vitamin K absence or antagonist-II (PIVKA-II) plus AFP could provide a valuable alternative. METHODS: This study compared the cost-utility of routine HCC surveillance using 'PIVKA-II + AFP' to the recommended standard-of-care in Hong Kong: surveillance using 'US + AFP'. A health economic model using a Markov-microsimulation framework was adapted using published local data and settings. The model was used to compare diagnostic outcomes, overall costs, quality-adjusted life years (QALYs), and cost-utility of the alternative HCC surveillance methods. RESULTS: Compared to the current recommended standard-of-care, the results suggested that HCC surveillance using 'PIVKA-II + AFP' could improve detection of HCC during early-stage disease by 4.6 percentage points, thus enabling access to more effective treatment options for some patients. It could also reduce false positive diagnoses by 7.2%, which could alleviate the need for costly confirmatory testing. Overall, PIVKA-II + AFP' was associated with a gain of 0.019 QALYs and cost savings of HK $ 4,144 per individual. The results were particularly favorable for non-cirrhotic CHB patients. CONCLUSIONS: HCC surveillance using 'PIVKA-II + AFP' could be a feasible option for patients with CHB and/ or LC who face limited access to ultrasound-based surveillance. The combination has the potential to improve early-stage HCC detection, facilitating timely intervention and improving both survival outcomes and patient quality of life.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a leading cause of cancer-related death in Hong Kong, with chronic hepatitis B infection and liver cirrhosis as common risk factors. Routine surveillance using ultrasound plus alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) is recommended but limited by access constraints.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This study compared the cost-utility of HCC surveillance using 'PIVKA-II + AFP' to the standard-of-care 'US + AFP' in Hong Kong. A health economic model using a Markov-microsimulation framework was adapted using published local data and settings.
analysis.methods: A Markov-microsimulation model was used to compare diagnostic outcomes, overall costs, quality-adjusted life years (QALYs), and cost-utility of 'PIVKA-II + AFP' versus 'US + AFP'. The model assessed early-stage detection rates, false positives, and economic impact per individual.
analysis.main_results: Surveillance using 'PIVKA-II + AFP' improved early-stage HCC detection by 4.6 percentage points and reduced false positives by 7.2%. It was associated with a gain of 0.019 QALYs and cost savings of HK $4,144 per individual, with particularly favorable results for non-cirrhotic chronic hepatitis B patients.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that 'PIVKA-II + AFP' could serve as a feasible alternative for patients with limited access to ultrasound, potentially improving early detection and patient outcomes. The novelty lies in demonstrating cost-effectiveness alongside diagnostic benefits in a local healthcare context.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that adopting 'PIVKA-II + AFP' surveillance could enhance HCC detection efficiency and reduce healthcare costs in Hong Kong, particularly for high-risk groups with restricted access to ultrasound.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is derived from a model-based analysis using published data, which may not fully capture real-world variability or long-term outcomes. The strength of evidence is moderate due to reliance on simulated data rather than prospective clinical trials.

The approach was particularly beneficial for non-cirrhotic chronic hepatitis B patients. The authors conclude that 'PIVKA-II + AFP' could be a feasible option for patients with limited access to ultrasound, potentially enhancing early detection and patient outcomes while reducing healthcare costs.
