elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 肝细胞癌(HCC)是香港癌症相关死亡的主要原因,其中慢性乙型肝炎感染和肝硬化是常见危险因素。建议使用超声加甲胎蛋白 (AFP) 进行常规监测,但受到准入限制。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究将香港使用“PIVKA-II + AFP”的 HCC 监测与标准护理“US + AFP”进行了成本效益比较。使用马尔可夫微观模拟框架的健康经济模型是根据已发布的当地数据和设置进行调整的。
elements_zh.methods: 使用马尔可夫微观模拟模型来比较“PIVKA-II + AFP”与“US + AFP”的诊断结果、总体成本、质量调整生命年 (QALY) 和成本效用。该模型评估了早期检测率、误报率和每个人的经济影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 使用“PIVKA-II + AFP”进行监测将早期 HCC 检出率提高了 4.6 个百分点,并将误报率降低了 7.2%。每位患者的 QALY 提高了 0.019 倍,成本节省了 4,144 港元,对于非肝硬化慢性乙型肝炎患者的结果尤其有利。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,“PIVKA-II + AFP”可以作为超声检查机会有限的患者的可行替代方案,有可能改善早期检测和患者预后。新颖之处在于在当地医疗保健环境中展示成本效益以及诊断优势。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,采用“PIVKA-II + AFP”监测可以提高香港的肝癌检测效率并降低医疗成本,特别是对于超声检查机会有限的高危人群。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据来自使用已发布数据进行的基于模型的分析,该分析可能无法完全捕捉现实世界的变异性或长期结果。由于依赖模拟数据而不是前瞻性临床试验,证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景与目的:肝细胞癌(HCC)是香港癌症相关死亡的主要原因。常见的危险因素包括慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 感染和/或肝硬化 (LC)。建议对患有这些疾病的患者使用超声加甲胎蛋白 (AFP) 进行常规 HCC 监测,但许多患者接受超声检查的机会仍然有限。对于这些情况,使用维生素 K 缺乏或拮抗剂 II (PIVKA-II) 诱导的蛋白质与 AFP 的组合进行基于生物标志物的监测可以提供一种有价值的替代方案。方法:本研究将使用“PIVKA-II + AFP”的常规 HCC 监测与香港推荐的护理标准:使用“US + AFP”的监测进行了成本效益比较。使用马尔可夫微观模拟框架的健康经济模型是根据已发布的当地数据和设置进行调整的。该模型用于比较替代 HCC 监测方法的诊断结果、总体成本、质量调整生命年 (QALY) 和成本效益。结果:与目前推荐的护理标准相比,结果表明使用“PIVKA-II + AFP”进行 HCC 监测可以将早期疾病期间 HCC 的检出率提高 4.6 个百分点,从而使一些患者能够获得更有效的治疗选择。它还可以将假阳性诊断减少 7.2%,从而减少对昂贵的确认性检测的需求。总体而言,PIVKA-II + AFP' 与每人 0.019 QALY 的增益和 4,144 港元的成本节省相关。结果对于非肝硬化慢性乙型肝炎患者尤其有利。结论:对于超声监测机会有限的 CHB 和/或 LC 患者,使用“PIVKA-II + AFP”进行 HCC 监测可能是一种可行的选择。该组合有可能改善早期 HCC 检测,促进及时干预并改善生存结果和患者生活质量。

analysis_zh.methods: 使用马尔可夫微观模拟模型来比较“PIVKA-II + AFP”与“US + AFP”的诊断结果、总体成本、质量调整生命年 (QALY) 和成本效用。该模型评估了早期检测率、误报率和每个人的经济影响。
analysis_zh.main_results: 使用“PIVKA-II + AFP”进行监测将早期 HCC 检出率提高了 4.6 个百分点,并将误报率降低了 7.2%。每位患者的 QALY 提高了 0.019 倍,成本节省了 4,144 港元,对于非肝硬化慢性乙型肝炎患者的结果尤其有利。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,“PIVKA-II + AFP”可以作为超声检查机会有限的患者的可行替代方案,有可能改善早期检测和患者预后。新颖之处在于在当地医疗保健环境中展示成本效益以及诊断优势。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,采用“PIVKA-II + AFP”监测可以提高香港的肝癌检测效率并降低医疗成本,特别是对于超声检查机会有限的高危人群。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据来自使用已发布数据进行的基于模型的分析,该分析可能无法完全捕捉现实世界的变异性或长期结果。由于依赖模拟数据而不是前瞻性临床试验,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Antiviral activity of novel chemical compound 0411, derived from FUBP1-IN-1 against hepatitis B virus by upregulation of DUSP5
papers.abstract: Current first-line drugs rarely achieve functional curesfor chronic hepatitis B patients, which urges us to explore novel anti-HBV therapeutic strategies. In this study, we found that the novel chemical compound 0411, a derivative of the FUBP1 inhibitor, FUBPI-IN-1, significantly suppressed HBV transcription both in vitro and in vivo. Transcriptome sequencing demonstrated that 0411 treatment markedly upregulated the expression of the dual-specificity phosphatase 5 (DUSP5) gene, a crucial regulator of the MAPK pathway. Further functional studies illustrated that the antiviral activity of compound 0411 was dependent on DUSP5. Mechanismly, 0411 treatment in HepG2-NTCP cells enhances the deposition of active histone modifications on the promoter of DUSP5 significantly. In conclusion, our findings demonstrate the potential of 0411 as an effective agent against HBV transcription.

papers.abstract_zh: 目前一线药物很少能对慢性乙型肝炎患者实现功能性治愈,这促使我们探索新的抗乙型肝炎治疗策略。在这项研究中,我们发现新型化合物 0411(FUBP1 抑制剂 FUBPI-IN-1 的衍生物)在体外和体内均显着抑制 HBV 转录。转录组测序表明,0411 处理显着上调了双特异性磷酸酶 5 (DUSP5) 基因的表达,该基因是 MAPK 通路的关键调节因子。进一步的功能研究表明,化合物0411的抗病毒活性依赖于DUSP5。从机制上来说,HepG2-NTCP 细胞中的 0411 处理显着增强了活性组蛋白修饰在 DUSP5 启动子上的沉积。总之,我们的研究结果证明了 0411 作为有效抗 HBV 转录药物的潜力。

papers.title: Hepatitis B knowledge, attitudes and practices among health-care workers in Vanuatu, 2024.
papers.abstract: Objective: The prevalence of chronic hepatitis B in Vanuatu is high, at approximately 9%. While immunization has been available for infants since 1989, subsets of the adult population remain susceptible, including health-care workers. Prior to a planned roll-out of hepatitis B vaccination for health-care workers, we conducted a knowledge, attitudes and practices survey to inform education programmes aimed at promoting vaccine uptake. Methods: Clinical and non-clinical health-care professionals at risk of occupational exposure to hepatitis B were invited to complete an online survey from April to June 2024. The survey sought information on hepatitis B knowledge (10 questions), attitudes (6 questions) and clinical practices (3 questions), as well as participant demographics. Participant knowledge scores were calculated and potential associations with demographic factors explored using Fisher's exact test. Results: Most of the 50 respondents were female (73%) and worked in either hospitals or the Ministry of Health (82%). Knowledge was high, with a median score of 9 (range: 3-10); 21 participants scored 100%. The proportion of incorrect responses was highest for questions related to treatment availability and transmission risks. We found no evidence of associations between demographic factors and knowledge scores. Most participants believed that hepatitis B vaccines were useful (88%) and prevention and control measures would protect them from infection (96%). Discussion: Our survey revealed high levels of knowledge and generally positive attitudes towards people with hepatitis B and infection control practices. While our respondents are unlikely to be representative of all health-care workers in Vanuatu, findings offer useful insights into specific knowledge gaps that could be addressed in planned health-care worker education sessions ahead of the vaccination roll-out.

papers.title_zh: 2024 年瓦努阿图医护人员的乙型肝炎知识、态度和实践。
papers.source_body_en: Objective: The prevalence of chronic hepatitis B in Vanuatu is high, at approximately 9%. While immunization has been available for infants since 1989, subsets of the adult population remain susceptible, including health-care workers. Prior to a planned roll-out of hepatitis B vaccination for health-care workers, we conducted a knowledge, attitudes and practices survey to inform education programmes aimed at promoting vaccine uptake. Methods: Clinical and non-clinical health-care professionals at risk of occupational exposure to hepatitis B were invited to complete an online survey from April to June 2024. The survey sought information on hepatitis B knowledge (10 questions), attitudes (6 questions) and clinical practices (3 questions), as well as participant demographics. Participant knowledge scores were calculated and potential associations with demographic factors explored using Fisher's exact test. Results: Most of the 50 respondents were female (73%) and worked in either hospitals or the Ministry of Health (82%). Knowledge was high, with a median score of 9 (range: 3-10); 21 participants scored 100%. The proportion of incorrect responses was highest for questions related to treatment availability and transmission risks. We found no evidence of associations between demographic factors and knowledge scores. Most participants believed that hepatitis B vaccines were useful (88%) and prevention and control measures would protect them from infection (96%). Discussion: Our survey revealed high levels of knowledge and generally positive attitudes towards people with hepatitis B and infection control practices. While our respondents are unlikely to be representative of all health-care workers in Vanuatu, findings offer useful insights into specific knowledge gaps that could be addressed in planned health-care worker education sessions ahead of the vaccination roll-out.
papers.abstract_zh: 目标:瓦努阿图慢性乙型肝炎的患病率很高,约为 9%。虽然自 1989 年以来婴儿就可以进行免疫接种,但部分成年人口仍然易感,其中包括卫生保健工作者。在计划向医护人员推出乙型肝炎疫苗接种之前,我们进行了一项知识、态度和做法调查,为旨在促进疫苗接种的教育计划提供信息。方法:邀请有乙型肝炎职业暴露风险的临床和非临床卫生保健专业人员于 2024 年 4 月至 6 月完成一项在线调查。该调查寻求乙型肝炎知识(10 个问题)、态度(6 个问题)和临床实践(3 个问题)以及参与者人口统计信息。计算参与者的知识分数,并使用费舍尔精确检验探索与人口统计因素的潜在关联。结果:50 名受访者中大多数是女性 (73%),并且在医院或卫生部工作 (82%)。知识水平较高,中位数为9分(范围:3-10);21名参与者得分为100%。对于与治疗可用性和传播风险相关的问题,错误回答的比例最高。我们没有发现人口因素与知识得分之间存在关联的证据。大多数参与者认为乙型肝炎疫苗有用(88%),并且预防和控制措施可以保护他们免受感染(96%)。讨论:我们的调查显示,人们对乙型肝炎患者和感染控制措施的了解水平较高,普遍持积极态度。虽然我们的受访者不太可能代表瓦努阿图的所有卫生保健工作者,但调查结果提供了有关具体知识差距的有用见解,这些差距可以在疫苗接种推出之前计划的卫生保健工作者教育课程中得到解决。

papers.title: Shear wave elastography-based intrahepatic heterogeneity quantification predicts prognosis in patients with hepatitis B virus-related acutely decompensated cirrhosis
papers.abstract: Abstract Purpose To quantify intrahepatic heterogeneity (IHH) across biomechanical and morphological dimensions using two-dimensional (2D) shear wave elastography (SWE) images, and integrate it into a multimodal model for predicting 5-year mortality in patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related acutely decompensated cirrhosis (ADC). Methods This retrospective study included 239 patients with HBV-ADC, randomly allocated into a training (n = 144) and a validation cohort (n = 95). Baseline clinical data, 2D SWE images, mean elasticity values, and 5-year outcomes were collected. Unsupervised K-means clustering was applied to local radiomic features extracted from spatially co-registered SWE and gray-scale regions of 2D-SWE images to derive dual-modality IHH scores. Using the training cohort, a multimodal model was developed via multivariate Cox regression, integrating independent clinical predictors, mean SWE values, and dual-modality IHH and radiomic scores. Result In the validation cohort, both the SWE- and gray-scale-derived IHH scores demonstrated robust prognostic value for 5-year mortality, achieving time-dependent areas under the curve (AUCs) of 0.826 and 0.795, and concordance indices (C-indices) of 0.736 and 0.692, respectively. For the multimodal model, SHAP analysis identified these IHH scores as the most critical determinants for individual risk stratification. Notably, this model elevated the AUC and C-index to 0.904 and 0.801, respectively, significantly outperforming all unimodal predictive models (all p

papers.title: An Exploratory Cost‐Utility Analysis of Screening and Treating Immigrants in Canada for Hepatitis D
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Hepatitis D is common among immigrants in Canada, who account for approximately 23% of the population and tend to originate from high‐endemic countries. Mortality rates are notably high among those with chronic infections, and immigrants are less likely to engage in screening and treatment services. This paper aims to assess the cost‐utility of screening and treating Hepatitis D Virus (HDV)‐positive immigrants in Canada compared with a scenario in which no screening is conducted. This analysis takes a public‐payer perspective, uses a lifetime time horizon with a 1.5% annual discount rate, and expresses costs in 2023 Canadian dollars. A state‐transition model representing the natural progression of chronic hepatitis B and hepatitis D was developed in TreeAge Pro and mapped onto three interventions: screening and treatment with bulevirtide; screening and treatment with pegylated interferon alfa‐2a; and screening and treatment with both bulevirtide and pegylated interferon alfa‐2a. The analysis was conducted in accordance with the guidelines of Canada's Drug Agency. The incremental cost‐effectiveness ratio (ICER) was estimated for each intervention. Model sensitivity was performed using both univariate and probabilistic sensitivity analyses. All screening and treatment strategies resulted in a reduction in cases of decompensated cirrhosis, hepatocellular carcinoma and liver death, with combination therapy demonstrating the most favourable outcomes. Nevertheless, HDV screening and treatment with pegylated interferon alfa‐2a monotherapy was the only cost‐effective strategy (ICER: $23,177/QALY). While monotherapy with pegylated interferon alfa‐2a proved cost‐effective, combination therapy with bulevirtide is likely more clinically effective and may be cost‐effective if treatment costs decrease significantly.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 丁型肝炎在加拿大移民中很常见,他们约占总人口的 23%,并且往往来自高流行国家。慢性感染者的死亡率特别高,而且移民参与筛查和治疗服务的可能性较小。本文旨在评估与不进行筛查的情况相比,在加拿大筛查和治疗丁型肝炎病毒 (HDV) 阳性移民的成本效益。该分析从公共付款人的角度出发,使用终身时间范围和 1.5% 的年度贴现率,并以 2023 年加元表示成本。TreeAge Pro 中开发了代表慢性乙型肝炎和丁型肝炎自然进展的状态转换模型,并映射到三种干预措施:筛查和布列韦肽治疗;聚乙二醇化干扰素α-2a的筛查和治疗;以及使用 bulevivirtide 和聚乙二醇化干扰素 α-2a 进行筛查和治疗。该分析是根据加拿大药物管理局的指导方针进行的。估算每次干预的增量成本效益比(ICER)。使用单变量和概率敏感性分析进行模型敏感性。所有筛查和治疗策略都减少了失代偿性肝硬化、肝细胞癌和肝死亡的病例,其中联合治疗显示出最有利的结果。尽管如此,HDV 筛查和聚乙二醇干扰素 α-2a 单药治疗是唯一具有成本效益的策略(ICER:23,177 美元/QALY)。虽然聚乙二醇化干扰素 α-2a 单一疗法被证明具有成本效益,但与布列韦肽联合治疗可能在临床上更有效,并且如果治疗成本显着降低,则可能具有成本效益。

papers.title: PD-1 blockade unleashes local hepatitis B virus-related B cell response inhibiting hepatocellular carcinoma.
papers.abstract: The prevailing notion is that effector T cell activation mediates anti-PD-1 efficacy in cancer. Here, we conducted a mechanistic study parallel to our phase 2 trial of perioperative anti-PD-1 therapy in patients with resectable recurrent hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) (NCT04615143) to study its mechanism of action. Late-recurrence patients present two distinct subtypes characterized by T cell or B cell dominant responses in the tumor microenvironment by dynamic single-cell multi-omics analysis. Clonal antibody repertoire analysis and spatially paired scRNA-seq/BCR-seq reveal somatic hypermutation promoting antibody binding against hepatitis B virus core antigen (HBcAg) within tumor tertiary lymphoid structures (TLSs) in these type B-late recurrence patients. Mechanistically, HBcAg is exported into the extracellular space, triggering local B cell and antibody responses and complement activation. In mice, these high-affinity HBcAg-reactive antibodies lead to complement-mediated antitumor activity with enhanced anti-PD-1 efficacy. Thus, we uncover enhanced anti-virus B cell immunity within the TLS as a mechanism to anti-PD-1 in HCC.

papers.abstract_zh: 普遍的观点是效应 T 细胞激活介导癌症中的抗 PD-1 功效。在这里,我们进行了一项与可切除复发性肝细胞癌 (HCC) 患者围手术期抗 PD-1 治疗 (NCT04615143) 患者的 2 期试验平行的机制研究,以研究其作用机制。通过动态单细胞多组学分析,晚期复发患者呈现出两种不同的亚型,其特征是肿瘤微环境中 T 细胞或 B 细胞占主导地位的反应。克隆抗体库分析和空间配对的 scRNA-seq/BCR-seq 揭示了在这些 B 型晚期复发患者中,体细胞超突变促进肿瘤三级淋巴结构 (TLS) 内针对乙型肝炎病毒核心抗原 (HBcAg) 的抗体结合。从机制上讲,HBcAg 被输出到细胞外空间,触发局部 B 细胞和抗体反应以及补体激活。在小鼠中,这些高亲和力 HBcAg 反应性抗体可产生补体介导的抗肿瘤活性,并增强抗 PD-1 功效。因此,我们发现 TLS 内增强的抗病毒 B 细胞免疫是 HCC 中抗 PD-1 的机制。

papers.title: Tissue-based detection of macrophage-associated YAP1-positive material in human acute liver injury: an exploratory immunopathological biopsy series.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Yes-associated protein 1 (YAP1), a downstream effector of the Hippo pathway, is implicated in hepatocellular stress, ductular reaction, and tissue repair. Experimental studies suggest that injured YAP1-activated hepatocytes can be cleared by Kupffer-cell phagocytosis, but corresponding human biopsy evidence remains limited. METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed seven adults who underwent clinically indicated liver biopsy within 10 days of initial presentation or referral admission for acute liver injury. Liver biopsy sections were assessed by hematoxylin and eosin staining, periodic acid-Schiff-diastase staining, YAP1 immunohistochemistry, and double immunofluorescence for YAP1 and CD68. Macrophage-associated YAP1-positive structures were operationally defined as YAP1-positive signals located within or immediately adjacent to CD68-positive macrophages in portal or periportal areas. The definition was intended to capture spatial association and was not intended to prove intracellular phagocytosis, molecular co-expression, or endogenous YAP1 expression by macrophages. Associations with peak Model for End-Stage Liver Disease (MELD) score and days to alanine aminotransferase (ALT) normalization were evaluated as exploratory analyses. RESULTS: The median age was 52 years, and etiologies included autoimmune hepatitis, primary biliary cholangitis-autoimmune hepatitis overlap, drug-induced liver injury, acute hepatitis B, and idiopathic acute liver injury. Liver biopsy was performed at a median of 5 days (range, 2-10 days) after initial presentation or referral admission. A median of nine portal tracts and five macrophage-associated YAP1-positive structures were evaluated per biopsy, yielding a median YAP1/CD68-positive portal-tract index of 58.3%. ALT normalized after a median of 26 days. The index showed a nominal inverse association with days to ALT normalization (Spearman rho = -0.86, p = 0.014; Pearson r = -0.79, p = 0.034), whereas MELD score was not significantly associated with the index or recovery time. Leave-one-out analyses retained the inverse direction but showed unstable significance because of the very small sample size. CONCLUSIONS: In this small exploratory biopsy series, YAP1-positive material was observed in spatial association with CD68-positive macrophages in early human acute liver injury. The YAP1/CD68-positive portal-tract index showed a hypothesis-generating relationship with biochemical recovery but should not be interpreted as a validated prognostic marker or proof of macrophage-mediated phagocytosis. Larger, etiology-specific studies with standardized biopsy timing, lineage markers, multiplex immunofluorescence, high-resolution imaging, and digital pathology are warranted.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们回顾性分析了 7 名成人,他们在因急性肝损伤首次就诊或转诊入院后 10 天内接受了有临床指征的肝活检。
elements_zh.methods: 通过苏木精和伊红染色、高碘酸希夫淀粉酶染色、YAP1 免疫组织化学以及 YAP1 和 CD68 双重免疫荧光对肝活检切片进行评估。巨噬细胞相关的 YAP1 阳性结构在操作上被定义为位于门脉或门脉区域 CD68 阳性巨噬细胞内或紧邻 CD68 阳性巨噬细胞的 YAP1 阳性信号。作为探索性分析,评估了终末期肝病模型 (MELD) 评分峰值和丙氨酸转氨酶 (ALT) 正常化天数之间的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: 每次活检评估了 9 个汇管束和 5 个巨噬细胞相关 YAP1 阳性结构的中位数,得出中位 YAP1/CD68 阳性汇管束指数为 58.3%。该指数与 ALT 正常化天数呈名义负相关(Spearman rho = -0.86,p = 0.014;Pearson r = -0.79,p = 0.034),而 MELD 评分与指数或恢复时间没有显着相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在这个小型探索性活检系列中,在人类早期急性肝损伤中观察到 YAP1 阳性物质与 CD68 阳性巨噬细胞存在空间关联。YAP1/CD68 阳性汇管指数显示与生化恢复存在假设生成关系,但不应被解释为经过验证的预后标志物或巨噬细胞介导的吞噬作用的证据。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 有必要进行更大规模、针对病因的研究,包括标准化活检时间、谱系标记、多重免疫荧光、高分辨率成像和数字病理学,以进一步研究这种空间关联。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 有必要进行更大规模、针对病因的研究,包括标准化活检时间、谱系标记、多重免疫荧光、高分辨率成像和数字病理学,以进一步研究这种空间关联。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量非常小的限制,导致留一分析的显着性不稳定。由于该研究的探索性和缺乏标准化方案,证据强度较低。

papers.title: Trends in the etiology of acute insult and underlying chronic liver disease in patients with acute-on-chronic liver failure: A retrospective study in Southwest China (2020–2023)
papers.abstract: The etiology of acute insults and underlying chronic liver disease in acute-on-chronic liver failure has evolved in recent years. This study examined etiological patterns and trends from 2020 to 2023 in Southwest China. This study is a retrospective analysis that included 346 patients diagnosed with acute-on-chronic liver failure according to the Asian pacific association for the study of liver criteria at our hospital from 2020 to 2023. The etiology of acute insult and chronic liver disease and changing trends from 2020 to 2023 were analyzed. The top 5 etiologies of acute insult were spontaneous hepatitis B virus (HBV) reactivation (45.4%), HBV reactivation due to nucleot(s)ide analog withdrawal (16.2%), drug-induced liver injury (16.2%), unknown (6.1%), and alcoholic hepatitis (4.6%). The top 5 etiologies of chronic liver disease were chronic hepatitis B (53.2%), HBV-associated cirrhosis (22.00%), chronic hepatitis B plus alcoholic hepatitis (6.6%), HBV plus alcoholic hepatitis-associated cirrhosis (6.4%), and alcoholic hepatitis-associated cirrhosis (3.8%). From 2020 to 2023, the percentage of patients with viral hepatitis initially declined and then increased. The percentage of patients with alcoholic hepatitis showed a slight declining trend. The proportion of HBV-associated cirrhosis increased from 18.8% to 29.9%. The percentage of patients with chronic hepatitis B plus alcoholic hepatitis decreased from 11.8% to 2.6%, respectively. Viral hepatitis, especially chronic hepatitis B, remains the leading cause of acute insult and underlying chronic liver disease in Southwest China. These findings underscore the need for targeted HBV management strategies.

papers.abstract_zh: 近年来,慢性肝衰竭急性损伤和潜在慢性肝病的病因学有所发展。本研究调查了 2020 年至 2023 年中国西南地区的病因模式和趋势。本研究为回顾性分析,纳入2020年至2023年在我院根据亚太肝病研究协会标准诊断为慢性肝衰竭的346例患者,分析2020年至2023年急性损伤和慢性肝病的病因及变化趋势。急性损伤的前5位病因是自发性乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)再激活(45.4%)、核苷类似物戒断引起的HBV再激活(16.2%)、药物性肝损伤(16.2%)、不明原因(6.1%)和酒精性肝炎(4.6%)。慢性肝病病因前5位依次为慢性乙型肝炎(53.2%)、乙型肝炎相关性肝硬化(22.00%)、慢性乙型肝炎合并酒精性肝炎(6.6%)、乙型肝炎合并酒精性肝炎相关性肝硬化(6.4%)、酒精性肝炎相关性肝硬化(3.8%)。2020年至2023年,病毒性肝炎患者比例先下降后上升。酒精性肝炎患者比例呈小幅下降趋势。HBV相关肝硬化的比例从18.8%上升至29.9%。慢性乙型肝炎加酒精性肝炎患者比例分别从11.8%下降至2.6%。病毒性肝炎,尤其是慢性乙型肝炎,仍然是中国西南地区急性损伤和潜在慢性肝病的主要原因。这些发现强调了有针对性的乙肝治疗策略的必要性。

papers.title: Skrining HBSAG untuk Deteksi Dini Infeksi Hepatitis B pada Populasi Dewasa di Kelurahan Semanan
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B remains a public health problem with the potential to cause chronic liver disease, cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Early detection through community-based screening is essential to improve case identification and prevent transmission. This community service activity aimed to conduct HBsAg screening and provide education regarding hepatitis B among the community. A total of 155 participants were involved, with a mean age of 46.49 ± 10.29 years and an age range of 19–80 years. Most participants were female, accounting for 109 individuals (70.3%), while males accounted for 46 individuals (29.7%). Screening results showed that 153 participants (98.7%) were HBsAg negative and 2 participants (1.3%) were HBsAg positive. Gender-based distribution demonstrated that all positive cases were found among female participants. The low proportion of HBsAg-positive results indicates that most screened individuals did not have active hepatitis B infection. Nevertheless, the identification of positive cases highlights the importance of regular screening and health education as strategies for early detection, prevention of liver disease complications, and control of hepatitis B transmission within the community.

papers.title: Novel HBx-interacting host cellular factors regulate dynamic nuclear and cytoplasmic localization of Hepatitis B virus X protein (HBx)
papers.abstract: The hepatitis B virus (HBV) X protein (HBx) is a key player in viral transcription, replication, and HBV-associated hepatocarcinogenesis. Several novel HBx-interacting host cellular factors: DDX1, DDX3, MOV10 RNA helicases, INI1/hSNF5 chromatin-remodeling factor, Rad18 DNA repair enzyme, and CPSF6 cleavage factor were identified. DDX1, DDX3, and MOV10 colocalized with HBx in cytoplasmic foci or aggregates. In contrast, INI1/hSNF5 and CPSF6 relocalized with HBx in nuclear speckles, interchromatin granule clusters (IGCs), and/or PML-nuclear bodies. Rad18 sequestered HBx in the nucleoli. Importantly, DDX3, MOV10, and INI1/hSNF5 restricted HBV replication, whereas CPSF6 facilitated HBV replication. Furthermore, DDX1 enhanced HBx-mediated NF-κB transcription, whereas MOV10 and Rad18 inhibited it. Altogether, HBx-interacting host factors determine dynamic nuclear and cytoplasmic localization of HBx and regulate HBV replication and HBx-mediated transcription.

papers.title_zh: 新型 HBx 相互作用宿主细胞因子调节乙型肝炎病毒 X 蛋白 (HBx) 的动态核和细胞质定位
papers.source_body_en: The hepatitis B virus (HBV) X protein (HBx) is a key player in viral transcription, replication, and HBV-associated hepatocarcinogenesis. Several novel HBx-interacting host cellular factors: DDX1, DDX3, MOV10 RNA helicases, INI1/hSNF5 chromatin-remodeling factor, Rad18 DNA repair enzyme, and CPSF6 cleavage factor were identified. DDX1, DDX3, and MOV10 colocalized with HBx in cytoplasmic foci or aggregates. In contrast, INI1/hSNF5 and CPSF6 relocalized with HBx in nuclear speckles, interchromatin granule clusters (IGCs), and/or PML-nuclear bodies. Rad18 sequestered HBx in the nucleoli. Importantly, DDX3, MOV10, and INI1/hSNF5 restricted HBV replication, whereas CPSF6 facilitated HBV replication. Furthermore, DDX1 enhanced HBx-mediated NF-κB transcription, whereas MOV10 and Rad18 inhibited it. Altogether, HBx-interacting host factors determine dynamic nuclear and cytoplasmic localization of HBx and regulate HBV replication and HBx-mediated transcription.
papers.abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) X 蛋白 (HBx) 在病毒转录、复制和 HBV 相关肝癌发生中发挥关键作用。鉴定了几种新的 HBx 相互作用宿主细胞因子:DDX1、DDX3、MOV10 RNA 解旋酶、INI1/hSNF5 染色质重塑因子、Rad18 DNA 修复酶和 CPSF6 裂解因子。DDX1、DDX3 和 MOV10 与 HBx 共定位于细胞质灶或聚集体中。相反,INI1/hSNF5 和 CPSF6 与 HBx 一起重新定位于核斑点、染色质间颗粒簇 (IGC) 和/或 PML 核体中。Rad18 将 HBx 隔离在核仁中。重要的是,DDX3、MOV10 和 INI1/hSNF5 限制 HBV 复制,而 CPSF6 促进 HBV 复制。此外,DDX1 增强 HBx 介导的 NF-κB 转录,而 MOV10 和 Rad18 抑制它。总而言之,HBx 相互作用的宿主因子决定 HBx 的动态核和细胞质定位,并调节 HBV 复制和 HBx 介导的转录。

papers.title: Development of a Triplex TaqMan Real-Time PCR Assay for Simultaneous Detection of Duck Hepatitis B Virus, Duck Adenovirus Type 3, and Streptococcus gallolyticus subsp. pasteurianus
papers.abstract: Duck hepatitis B virus (DHBV), Duck adenovirus 3 (DAdV-3) and Streptococcus gallolyticus subsp. pasteurianus (SGSP) are three distinct pathogens associated with infectious diseases in waterfowl. Clinical differentiation among these agents is often difficult due to overlapping signs, underscoring the need for accurate, rapid, and simultaneous diagnostic tools to support early detection and effective disease surveillance. In this study, we developed and validated a triplex TaqMan real-time quantitative PCR (qPCR) assay for the simultaneous detection and quantification of DHBV, DAdV-3, and SGSP. The assay indicated high analytical sensitivity, achieving detection limits of 10 copies/μL for each target, with all standard curves showing excellent linearity (R2 = 0.999). The evaluation of specificity showed that the triplex qPCR assay had high specificity for the three target pathogens, as it did not yield any cross-reactive signals with other pathogens examined. Intra-assay and inter-assay coefficients of variation for recombinant plasmid standards were consistently <2%, indicating high reproducibility. Meanwhile, the assay was employed to investigate the epidemiology of the three pathogens in ducks. The positive rates for DHBV, DAdV-3 and SGSP were 73.95% (159/215), 11.16% (24/215) and 37.21% (80/215), respectively. The co-infection rates were 5.58% (12/215) for DHBV and DAdV-3, 27.91% (60/215) for DHBV and SGSP, 2.33% (5/215) for DAdV-3 and SGSP, and 2.33% (5/215) for all three pathogens. In summary, this triplex qPCR assay displays excellent specificity, sensitivity and repeatability, which may serve as a reliable testing tool for routine clinical diagnosis, epidemiological monitoring and co-infection screening of the three target pathogens in locally sampled duck populations.

papers.title_zh: 开发用于同时检测鸭乙型肝炎病毒、鸭腺病毒 3 型和溶没食子链球菌亚种的三重 TaqMan 实时 PCR 检测。巴氏杆菌
papers.source_body_en: Duck hepatitis B virus (DHBV), Duck adenovirus 3 (DAdV-3) and Streptococcus gallolyticus subsp. pasteurianus (SGSP) are three distinct pathogens associated with infectious diseases in waterfowl. Clinical differentiation among these agents is often difficult due to overlapping signs, underscoring the need for accurate, rapid, and simultaneous diagnostic tools to support early detection and effective disease surveillance. In this study, we developed and validated a triplex TaqMan real-time quantitative PCR (qPCR) assay for the simultaneous detection and quantification of DHBV, DAdV-3, and SGSP. The assay indicated high analytical sensitivity, achieving detection limits of 10 copies/μL for each target, with all standard curves showing excellent linearity (R2 = 0.999). The evaluation of specificity showed that the triplex qPCR assay had high specificity for the three target pathogens, as it did not yield any cross-reactive signals with other pathogens examined. Intra-assay and inter-assay coefficients of variation for recombinant plasmid standards were consistently <2%, indicating high reproducibility. Meanwhile, the assay was employed to investigate the epidemiology of the three pathogens in ducks. The positive rates for DHBV, DAdV-3 and SGSP were 73.95% (159/215), 11.16% (24/215) and 37.21% (80/215), respectively. The co-infection rates were 5.58% (12/215) for DHBV and DAdV-3, 27.91% (60/215) for DHBV and SGSP, 2.33% (5/215) for DAdV-3 and SGSP, and 2.33% (5/215) for all three pathogens. In summary, this triplex qPCR assay displays excellent specificity, sensitivity and repeatability, which may serve as a reliable testing tool for routine clinical diagnosis, epidemiological monitoring and co-infection screening of the three target pathogens in locally sampled duck populations.
papers.abstract_zh: 鸭乙型肝炎病毒 (DHBV)、鸭腺病毒 3 (DAdV-3) 和溶没食子链球菌亚种。巴氏杆菌 (SGSP) 是与水禽传染病相关的三种不同病原体。由于症状重叠,这些药物之间的临床区分通常很困难,这凸显了需要准确、快速和同步的诊断工具来支持早期检测和有效的疾病监测。在本研究中,我们开发并验证了三重 TaqMan 实时定量 PCR (qPCR) 测定法,用于同时检测和定量 DHBV、DAdV-3 和 SGSP。该测定显示出高分析灵敏度,每个目标的检测限达到 10 拷贝/μL,所有标准曲线均显示出出色的线性(R2 = 0.999)。特异性评估表明,三重 qPCR 检测对三种目标病原体具有高度特异性,因为它没有与其他检查的病原体产生任何交叉反应信号。重组质粒标准品的测定内和测定间变异系数始终<2%,表明高重现性。同时,采用该方法对鸭体内三种病原体的流行病学进行了调查。DHBV、DAdV-3和SGSP的阳性率分别为73.95%(159/215)、11.16%(24/215)和37.21%(80/215)。DHBV和DAdV-3的共感染率为5.58%(12/215),DHBV和SGSP的共感染率为27.91%(60/215),DAdV-3和SGSP的共感染率为2.33%(5/215),三种病原体的共感染率为2.33%(5/215)。总之,该三重 qPCR 检测显示出优异的特异性、敏感性和重复性,可作为当地采样鸭群中三种目标病原体的常规临床诊断、流行病学监测和共感染筛查的可靠检测工具。

papers.title: Optimizing Hepatitis B screening: A comparison of ELISA and rapid tests
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B remains a major global public health problem, particularly in areas of high endemicity such as Madagascar, where prevalence exceeds 8%. Diagnosis relies primarily on the ELISA immunoenzymatic technique, which is recognized for its reliability but is not widely available in resource-limited laboratories. Rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) offer a practical alternative, but their performance in this context has yet to be evaluated. This prospective descriptive and analytical study compared the performance of the Virucheck® rapid test and the Wantai Bio Pharm ELISA for the detection of hepatitis B virus surface antigen (HBsAg). The sample consisted of 74 serum samples from patients with sickle cell disease and subjects followed at the JRA University Hospital. The results showed a seroprevalence of 6.75% by TDR versus 9.45% by ELISA. The TDR had a sensitivity of 71.41% and a specificity of 100%, while the ELISA confirmed its superiority with sensitivities exceeding 95% and specificities close to 98%. Beyond technical performance, the study highlighted a predominantly young population, reflecting the significance of mother-to-child transmission, as well as a notable seroprevalence among young adults linked to risky sexual behaviors. These findings underscore the urgency of early and targeted screening, combined with a strengthened vaccination strategy. In conclusion, optimizing hepatitis B screening in Madagascar relies on the complementary use of rapid tests—suitable for community-based screening—and ELISA, which is essential for diagnostic confirmation and clinical follow-up. This approach represents a strategic pathway to reduce transmission, improve vaccination coverage, and strengthen the fight against hepatitis B in a context of high endemicity.

papers.title: Combined percutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation and ultrasound-guided phrenic nerve block for persistent hiccups: A case report.
papers.abstract: RATIONALE: Persistent hiccups lasting more than 48 hours are rare but can markedly impair quality of life. Conventional therapies are often limited by transient efficacy, side effects, invasiveness, highlighting the need for safer and more effective options. PATIENT CONCERNS: A 62-year-old male with chronic hepatitis B, hypertension, type 2 diabetes, prior pulmonary tuberculosis, and gastrointestinal disorders presented with fever for 7 days and persistent hiccups for 4 days, occurring at a frequency of 40 to 50 times per minute. Symptoms significantly interfered with eating, sleeping, and daily activities. DIAGNOSES: After excluding central nervous system and metabolic causes, the patient was diagnosed with persistent hiccups associated with pulmonary infection and gastrointestinal dysfunction. INTERVENTIONS: An initial ultrasound-guided phrenic nerve block provided transient relief for about 4 hours. Subsequently, combined therapy with daily phrenic nerve block and twice-daily percutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation (aVNS) was administered for 3 consecutive days. OUTCOMES: By day 7, the hiccups had resolved completely, with the hiccups assessment instrument score decreasing from 9 to 0 and the Pittsburgh sleep quality index score improving from 16 to 2. After initiation of aVNS, the patient was followed up for 1 month after discharge. No recurrence of persistent hiccups, delayed complications, or treatment-related adverse events were observed during follow-up. LESSONS: This case suggests that ultrasound-guided phrenic nerve block combined with aVNS may offer a minimally invasive, safe, and effective treatment option for persistent hiccups unresponsive to conventional therapy. Larger studies are warranted to validate efficacy and long-term outcomes.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:持续呃逆超过48小时罕见,但可严重影响生活质量。常规治疗因效果短暂、副作用及侵入性等局限,亟需更安全有效的替代方案。患者情况:一名62岁男性,既往患有慢性乙型肝炎、高血压、2型糖尿病、肺结核及胃肠道疾病,入院时发热7天,持续呃逆4天,呃逆频率为每分钟40至50次。症状严重干扰进食、睡眠及日常活动。诊断:排除中枢神经系统及代谢性病因后,诊断为与肺部感染及胃肠功能障碍相关的持续呃逆。干预措施:首次超声引导下膈神经阻滞仅暂时缓解约4小时。随后采用每日膈神经阻滞联合每日两次经皮耳迷走神经刺激(aVNS)的综合治疗,持续3天。结局:至第7天呃逆完全消失,呃逆评估工具评分从9降至0,匹兹堡睡眠质量指数评分从16降至2。aVNS启动后,患者出院后随访1个月。随访期间未观察到持续呃逆复发、延迟并发症或与治疗相关的不良事件。经验教训:本病例提示,超声引导下膈神经阻滞联合aVNS可能为对常规治疗无效的持续呃逆提供一种微创、安全且有效的治疗选择。有待更大规模研究验证其疗效及长期结局。

papers.title: Recent Progress in the Synthesis of Entecavir
papers.abstract: Entecavir, as the most effective hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA polymerase inhibitor currently used in the clinical treatment of chronic hepatitis B, holds significant clinical value. This paper systematically reviews the latest research advances (2012–2025) in the total synthesis of entecavir. Based on the differences in synthetic strategies for constructing its core cyclopentane skeleton, existing synthetic routes are categorized into three types: Carbon ring construction strategies mediated by cycloaddition and ring‐closing metathesis, multi‐catalytic cascade and fully catalytic asymmetric synthesis strategies, and stereoselective epoxide transformation and tandem reaction strategies. This classification not only clearly presents the technical characteristics of different synthetic approaches but also provides an important reference for the development of carbocyclic nucleoside analogs.

papers.title: Case Report: Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma With "Wine Glass" Sign Presenting as Somnolence and Fatigue.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND Primary central nervous system lymphoma (PCNSL) is a rare and aggressive extranodal non-Hodgkin lymphoma with highly heterogeneous clinical and imaging manifestations. Its atypical manifestations often lead to critical differential diagnosis challenges, resulting in high rates of misdiagnosis and delayed diagnosis. CASE REPORT We report a case of PCNSL in a 55-year-old male patient. The patient was a chronic hepatitis B virus carrier, with a history of consumption of medicinal wine with unknown ingredients 1 month prior to onset. He presented with progressive somnolence and generalized fatigue as the core initial symptoms, accompanied by other non-focal neurological deficits, including fever, altered mental status and cognitive impairment. Brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) revealed abnormal signals around the third ventricle and midbrain aqueduct, with a rare "wine glass" sign. In contrast, multiple contrast-enhanced MRI scans showed no typical homogeneous enhancement signals. Tumor cells were found in the third cerebrospinal fluid analysis, and he was definitively diagnosed with PCNSL after stereotactic biopsy. The patient's symptoms improved following a single fraction of radiotherapy treatment. CONCLUSIONS The insidious onset and atypical features of PCNSL increase the risk of delaying diagnosis, which may negatively impact patient outcomes. Here, we present a case of PCNSL exhibiting atypical clinical manifestations and imaging findings, while differentiating it from other neurological disorders with overlapping features. It also highlights the critical value of serial cerebrospinal fluid cytology and early biopsy for timely diagnosis, providing a clinical reference for managing similar cases.

papers.title_zh: 病例报告:原发性中枢神经系统淋巴瘤,伴有“酒杯”征,表现为嗜睡和疲劳。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND Primary central nervous system lymphoma (PCNSL) is a rare and aggressive extranodal non-Hodgkin lymphoma with highly heterogeneous clinical and imaging manifestations. Its atypical manifestations often lead to critical differential diagnosis challenges, resulting in high rates of misdiagnosis and delayed diagnosis. CASE REPORT We report a case of PCNSL in a 55-year-old male patient. The patient was a chronic hepatitis B virus carrier, with a history of consumption of medicinal wine with unknown ingredients 1 month prior to onset. He presented with progressive somnolence and generalized fatigue as the core initial symptoms, accompanied by other non-focal neurological deficits, including fever, altered mental status and cognitive impairment. Brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) revealed abnormal signals around the third ventricle and midbrain aqueduct, with a rare "wine glass" sign. In contrast, multiple contrast-enhanced MRI scans showed no typical homogeneous enhancement signals. Tumor cells were found in the third cerebrospinal fluid analysis, and he was definitively diagnosed with PCNSL after stereotactic biopsy. The patient's symptoms improved following a single fraction of radiotherapy treatment. CONCLUSIONS The insidious onset and atypical features of PCNSL increase the risk of delaying diagnosis, which may negatively impact patient outcomes. Here, we present a case of PCNSL exhibiting atypical clinical manifestations and imaging findings, while differentiating it from other neurological disorders with overlapping features. It also highlights the critical value of serial cerebrospinal fluid cytology and early biopsy for timely diagnosis, providing a clinical reference for managing similar cases.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景原发性中枢神经系统淋巴瘤(PCNSL)是一种罕见的侵袭性结外非霍奇金淋巴瘤,具有高度异质性的临床和影像学表现。其非典型表现常常导致关键的鉴别诊断挑战,导致误诊和延误诊断率很高。病例报告 我们报告一例 55 岁男性患者的 PCNSL 病例。患者为慢性乙型肝炎病毒携带者,发病前1个月有饮用不明成分药酒史。他以进行性嗜睡和全身疲劳为核心初始症状,并伴有其他非局灶性神经功能缺损,包括发烧、精神状态改变和认知障碍。脑部磁共振成像(MRI)显示第三脑室和中脑导水管周围存在异常信号,并有罕见的“酒杯”征。相反,多次对比增强 MRI 扫描未显示典型的均匀增强信号。第三次脑脊液分析发现肿瘤细胞,立体定向活检后确诊PCNSL。经过一次放射治疗后,患者的症状有所改善。结论 PCNSL 的起病隐匿和非典型特征增加了延误诊断的风险,这可能对患者的治疗结果产生负面影响。在此,我们介绍一例 PCNSL 病例,该病例表现出非典型的临床表现和影像学表现,同时将其与具有重叠特征的其他神经系统疾病区分开来。它还强调了连续脑脊液细胞学检查和早期活检对于及时诊断的关键价值,为处理类似病例提供临床参考。

papers.title: Terapias en enfermedades inflamatorias intestinales en situaciones especiales: tuberculosis, infección por VIH, virus hepatitis B y paciente crítico
papers.abstract: Introducción: La enfermedad inflamatoria intestinal (EII) en situaciones especiales constituye un desafío clínico. La inmunosupresión sostenida predispone a infecciones oportunistas y a la reactivación de infecciones latentes, mientras que determinadas comorbilidades condicionan decisiones terapéuticas que escapan a los protocolos convencionales. Objetivo: Revisar la evidencia disponible sobre el manejo de cuatro situaciones especiales en la EII: tuberculosis (TBC), infección por VIH, hepatitis B (VHB) y paciente crítico. Métodos: Revisión narrativa basada en búsqueda sistemática en PubMed, guías ECCO, GETECCU, ACG y GETAID, priorizando publicaciones de los últimos cinco años. Resultados: El tamizaje de TBC latente es obligatorio antes de iniciar cualquier biológico, con riesgo de reactivación hasta 20 veces mayor con anti-TNF. El VIH aumenta el riesgo de desarrollar EII (OR 2,68) y confiere un fenotipo menos agresivo, pero mayor riesgo de infecciones oportunistas; los biológicos son seguros con VIH con carga viral negativa. El VHB requiere tamizaje serológico universal y profilaxis antiviral obligatoria en pacientes HBsAg positivos. El paciente crítico con EII demanda manejo multidisciplinario con evaluación precoz del riesgo quirúrgico, soporte nutricional intensivo y consideración de terapias de rescate según disponibilidad y contraindicaciones. Conclusiones: El manejo de la EII en situaciones especiales requiere decisiones individualizadas, fundamentadas en la mejor evidencia disponible y en un abordaje multidisciplinario.

papers.title_zh: 特殊情况下肠道炎症的治疗:结核病、VIH 感染、乙型病毒性肝炎和重症患者
papers.source_body_en: Introducción: La enfermedad inflamatoria intestinal (EII) en situaciones especiales constituye un desafío clínico. La inmunosupresión sostenida predispone a infecciones oportunistas y a la reactivación de infecciones latentes, mientras que determinadas comorbilidades condicionan decisiones terapéuticas que escapan a los protocolos convencionales. Objetivo: Revisar la evidencia disponible sobre el manejo de cuatro situaciones especiales en la EII: tuberculosis (TBC), infección por VIH, hepatitis B (VHB) y paciente crítico. Métodos: Revisión narrativa basada en búsqueda sistemática en PubMed, guías ECCO, GETECCU, ACG y GETAID, priorizando publicaciones de los últimos cinco años. Resultados: El tamizaje de TBC latente es obligatorio antes de iniciar cualquier biológico, con riesgo de reactivación hasta 20 veces mayor con anti-TNF. El VIH aumenta el riesgo de desarrollar EII (OR 2,68) y confiere un fenotipo menos agresivo, pero mayor riesgo de infecciones oportunistas; los biológicos son seguros con VIH con carga viral negativa. El VHB requiere tamizaje serológico universal y profilaxis antiviral obligatoria en pacientes HBsAg positivos. El paciente crítico con EII demanda manejo multidisciplinario con evaluación precoz del riesgo quirúrgico, soporte nutricional intensivo y consideración de terapias de rescate según disponibilidad y contraindicaciones. Conclusiones: El manejo de la EII en situaciones especiales requiere decisiones individualizadas, fundamentadas en la mejor evidencia disponible y en un abordaje multidisciplinario.
papers.abstract_zh: 简介:肠道炎症 (EII) 是一种特殊的临床情况。免疫抑制的作用是预防机会性感染和潜伏性感染的重新激活,这取决于公约协议中的治疗决定。目的:修订 EII 中特殊情况的证据:结核病 (TBC)、VIH 感染、乙型肝炎 (VHB) 和重症监护。方法:在 PubMed 系统中修改 basada 叙事,参考 ECCO、GETECCU、ACG 和 GETAID,优先考虑最近几年的公共事务。结果:TBC 潜伏期和生物生物学启动前的必要条件,与抗 TNF 药物一起重新激活已达 20 次。El VIH aumenta el riesgo de desarrollar EII (OR 2,68) y confiere un fenotipo menos agresivo,pero Mayor riesgo de infecciones opportunistas;生物制剂可以保护 VIH 和病毒阴性。VHB 需要针对 HBsAg 阳性患者进行普遍的血清学和抗病毒治疗。EII 的Paciente crítico 要求对所需的营养进行多学科评估,支持强化营养并考虑采取补救措施和禁忌症的治疗方法。结论:EII 的具体情况需要个性化决策、主要证据和跨学科基础。

papers.title: Safety assessment for hepatectomy in patients with hepatocellular carcinoma combined with hepatitis B-related cirrhosis: Expert consensus
papers.abstract: In China, more than 80% of patients with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) have varying degrees of cirrhosis caused by hepatitis B virus infection. Unlike in Western countries, hepatectomy remains one of the main treatment options for patients with HCC and cirrhosis in China. The severity of cirrhosis varies considerably among individual patients with HCC. Although liver function may remain within the normal range during the compensated stage, progressive cirrhosis significantly reduces hepatic functional reserve and regenerative capacity. As a result, the incidence of postoperative complications and liver failure increases after hepatectomy. Therefore, hepatectomy that preserves as much liver parenchyma as possible is required to ensure surgical safety in patients with different degrees of cirrhosis. At present, the impact of different degrees of cirrhosis on the risk of posthepatectomy liver failure in patients with HCC is not fully understood. In addition, no consensus has been established regarding the optimal surgical approach for patients with HCC and varying severities of cirrhosis. This gap represents an important factor affecting the safety of hepatectomy. Reducing the incidence of postoperative liver failure and mortality in patients with HCC and cirrhosis remains an important issue that requires further investigation. The Chinese Chapter of the International Hepato-Pancreato-Biliary Association, Group of Liver Surgery of the Chinese Society of Surgery, invited leading domestic experts in hepatobiliary surgery and hepatology to discuss the role of cirrhosis severity in the safety assessment of hepatectomy for HCC and strategies to improve surgical safety. This consensus aims to assist hepatobiliary surgeons in making appropriate surgical decisions for patients with HCC and cirrhosis, and to improve surgical safety.

papers.abstract_zh: 在我国,80%以上的肝细胞癌(HCC)患者因乙型肝炎病毒感染而出现不同程度的肝硬化。与西方国家不同,肝切除术仍然是中国肝癌和肝硬化患者的主要治疗选择之一。肝细胞癌患者的肝硬化严重程度差异很大。尽管在代偿阶段肝功能可能保持在正常范围内,但进行性肝硬化会显着降低肝功能储备和再生能力。因此,肝切除术后术后并发症和肝功能衰竭的发生率增加。因此,对于不同程度的肝硬化患者,需要尽可能保留肝实质的肝切除术以确保手术安全。目前,不同程度的肝硬化对HCC患者肝切除术后肝衰竭风险的影响尚不完全清楚。此外,对于 HCC 和不同严重程度的肝硬化患者的最佳手术方法尚未达成共识。这一差距是影响肝切除术安全性的重要因素。降低肝癌和肝硬化患者术后肝衰竭的发生率和死亡率仍然是需要进一步研究的重要问题。国际肝胰胆协会中国分会、中华外科学会肝脏外科学组邀请国内肝胆外科和肝病学领域顶尖专家,共同探讨肝硬化严重程度在肝癌肝切除安全性评估中的作用以及提高手术安全性的策略。该共识旨在协助肝胆外科医生对HCC合并肝硬化患者做出适当的手术决策,并提高手术安全性。

papers.title: UHPLC-Orbitrap-HRMS-based metabolite identification and profiling of methylophiopogonone A, A bioactive constituent from Ophiopogon japonicus.
papers.abstract: Methylophiopogonone A (MON-A), an anti-inflammatory constituent of Ophiopogon japonicus, demonstrates therapeutic potential for liver fibrosis in patients with chronic hepatitis B and SARS-CoV-2 infection. This study aimed to investigate its metabolic profile using liver microsomes and cryopreserved hepatocytes from humans and three preclinical species (rat, dog, and monkey). MON-A was incubated separately with each system, and the samples were analyzed by ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography coupled with quadrupole/Orbitrap high-resolution mass spectrometry (UHPLC-Orbitrap-HRMS) in positive electrospray ionization mode. Data were processed using Compound Discoverer software with mass defect filtering. Metabolite structures were characterized based on accurate mass and MS2 fragment ions. A total of 14 metabolites were identified. The primary metabolic pathways included hydroxylation, oxidative methylenedioxyphenyl (MDP) ring-opening, oxidation, and glucuronidation. M11 (a glucuronide conjugate) was the most abundant metabolite across all species. Additionally, four glutathione (GSH) conjugates were detected, indicating the formation of reactive metabolites, notably ortho-quinone and quinone methide species. The formation of quinone methide species revealed that C2-C3 double bond is essential for the metabolic activation of the A-ring. This systematic study clarifies the metabolic fate of MON-A, providing important insights into its biotransformation pathways and potential for reactive metabolite formation. The results establish a foundation for evaluating both the therapeutic efficacy and safety profile of this anti-inflammatory candidate during preclinical development.

papers.abstract_zh: 甲基麦冬酮 A (MON-A) 是麦冬的一种抗炎成分,具有治疗慢性乙型肝炎和 SARS-CoV-2 感染患者肝纤维化的潜力。本研究旨在利用人类和三种临床前物种(大鼠、狗和猴子)的肝微粒体和冷冻保存的肝细胞来研究其代谢特征。MON-A 与每个系统分别孵育,并通过超高效液相色谱结合四极杆/Orbitrap 高分辨率质谱 (UHPLC-Orbitrap-HRMS) 在正电喷雾电离模式下对样品进行分析。使用具有质量缺陷过滤功能的Compound Discoverer 软件处理数据。根据精确质量和 MS2 碎片离子对代谢物结构进行表征。总共鉴定出 14 种代谢物。主要代谢途径包括羟基化、氧化亚甲基二氧苯基(MDP)开环、氧化和葡萄糖醛酸化。M11(一种葡萄糖醛酸结合物)是所有物种中最丰富的代谢物。此外,还检测到四种谷胱甘肽(GSH)缀合物,表明形成了反应性代谢物,特别是邻醌和醌甲基化物。醌甲基化物的形成表明C2-C3双键对于A环的代谢活化至关重要。这项系统研究阐明了 MON-A 的代谢命运,为其生物转化途径和反应性代谢物形成的潜力提供了重要见解。结果为评估这种抗炎候选药物在临床前开发过程中的治疗效果和安全性奠定了基础。

papers.title: In Silico Studies of the Hepatitis B Virus Polymerase: Efforts to Identify Novel Drug Binding Sites to Inhibit HBV Replication.
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) replicates via reverse transcription, a reaction catalyzed by the HBV polymerase (P) protein. P is a multidomain protein consists of terminal protein, spacer, reverse transcriptase, and ribonuclease H domains. We used a predicted structural model of HBV P and computationally identified potential non-nucleos(t)ide reverse transcriptase inhibitor (NNRTI) sites. Out of the three potential NNRTI sites, we selected Site 3 for virtual high throughput screening of 837,000 virtual compounds. We selected 53 compounds considering their docking scores, ligand uniqueness, stability and rigidity for screening in HBV replication inhibition assay, but all of them failed to suppress the HBV reverse transcription. Molecular dynamic simulations showed that Site 3 binding pocket is not conformationally stable even after binding of the ligand. This study indicates that additional potential NNRTI sites should be explored, and that rigorous molecular dynamic simulations studies should be performed before virtual compound screening.

papers.title_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒聚合酶的计算机研究:努力确定抑制 HBV 复制的新药物结合位点。
papers.source_body_en: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) replicates via reverse transcription, a reaction catalyzed by the HBV polymerase (P) protein. P is a multidomain protein consists of terminal protein, spacer, reverse transcriptase, and ribonuclease H domains. We used a predicted structural model of HBV P and computationally identified potential non-nucleos(t)ide reverse transcriptase inhibitor (NNRTI) sites. Out of the three potential NNRTI sites, we selected Site 3 for virtual high throughput screening of 837,000 virtual compounds. We selected 53 compounds considering their docking scores, ligand uniqueness, stability and rigidity for screening in HBV replication inhibition assay, but all of them failed to suppress the HBV reverse transcription. Molecular dynamic simulations showed that Site 3 binding pocket is not conformationally stable even after binding of the ligand. This study indicates that additional potential NNRTI sites should be explored, and that rigorous molecular dynamic simulations studies should be performed before virtual compound screening.
papers.abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 通过逆转录进行复制,这是一种由 HBV 聚合酶 (P) 蛋白催化的反应。P 是一种多结构域蛋白,由末端蛋白、间隔区、逆转录酶和核糖核酸酶 H 结构域组成。我们使用了 HBV P 的预测结构模型,并通过计算确定了潜在的非核苷(酸)逆转录酶抑制剂 (NNRTI) 位点。在三个潜在的 NNRTI 位点中,我们选择了位点 3 对 837,000 种虚拟化合物进行虚拟高通量筛选。考虑到其对接分数、配体独特性、稳定性和刚性,我们选择了 53 个化合物进行 HBV 复制抑制试验的筛选,但均未能抑制 HBV 逆转录。分子动力学模拟表明,即使在配体结合后,位点 3 结合袋也不是构象稳定的。这项研究表明,应探索其他潜在的 NNRTI 位点,并在虚拟化合物筛选之前进行严格的分子动力学模拟研究。

papers.title: Hepatocellular Carcinoma in Africa: Epidemiology, Prevention and Outcomes
papers.abstract: Purpose of review: This review synthesizes the current knowledge of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) epidemiology across Northern and sub-Saharan Africa. We examine how causes of HCC differ by region, highlight prevention and early detection strategies, and identify gaps in treatment and palliative care to improve outcomes. Recent findings: The causes of HCC vary markedly across the continent. HCV predominates in Northern Africa, whereas HBV infection and dietary aflatoxin exposure prevail in sub-Saharan Africa. Rising obesity, diabetes, harmful alcohol use, and hepatitis D co-infection are important but under-researched contributors. Most patients still present with advanced disease, fewer than 6% receive curative therapy, median survival is measured in months, and access to palliative care remains dismal. Summary: HCC poses a major challenge in Africa, marked by high incidence, early age at diagnosis, and among the worst survival outcomes worldwide. Primary prevention through HBV birth-dose vaccination, aflatoxin mitigation, and population-level HCV treatment offers the most effective way to reduce mortality, yet implementation barriers persist.

papers.title: Real-World Safety and Effectiveness of Cabotegravir in People Living with HIV: Interim Report of a Post-marketing Surveillance in Japan.
papers.abstract: Cabotegravir (CAB) is an integrase strand transfer inhibitor and the first long-acting injectable antiretroviral agent for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), administered with rilpivirine. Because approval in Japan relied largely on overseas and international collaborative trials, domestic real-world evidence remains limited. This study evaluated the real-world safety and effectiveness of CAB in people living with HIV (PLHIV) in Japan. This interim analysis (June 27, 2022 and June 17, 2025) was part of an ongoing post-marketing surveillance of Japanese PLHIV treated with CAB at institutions participating in the HIV-related Drugs Cooperative Survey. Safety was assessed by the incidence of adverse drug reactions (ADRs). Associations between ADR incidence and background characteristics were examined using Fisher’s exact and χ2 tests without multiplicity adjustment. Effectiveness was evaluated using virologic suppression assessed by log-transformed HIV RNA copies/mL and peripheral CD4+ cell counts. A total of 121 and 117 participants were included in the safety and efficacy analysis sets, respectively; most were aged over 20 years, and over 96% were male participants. Overall, 76 ADRs were reported in 45 participants (37.19%). The most frequent ADRs were injection site pain and musculoskeletal pain (12.40% each). Four serious ADRs that were not explicitly deemed unrelated to CAB by the reporting physicians occurred in 4 participants: hepatitis B reactivation, monkeypox, syphilis, and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Stratification analyses by participant characteristics revealed high ADR incidences among participants aged ≥ 30 to < 40 years (p = 0.038), without allergy (p = 0.016), and with comorbidities (p = 0.045). HIV RNA copies remained suppressed and CD4+ cell counts were maintained at levels comparable to treatment initiation throughout follow-up. This interim analysis indicates that CAB therapy is safe, with no new safety signals, and effective, as demonstrated by sustained virological suppression and stable CD4+ cell counts. These findings are consistent with outcomes reported in overseas and international collaborative clinical studies. Taking multiple oral medications every day can be challenging for people living with human immunodeficiency virus (PLHIV). Cabotegravir, co-administered with rilpivirine, is the first long-acting injectable HIV treatment that can be given once monthly or every 2 months. Its approval in Japan was primarily based on overseas and international collaborative studies, and real-world clinical evidence in Japan has been limited. To address this gap, a post-marketing surveillance has been conducted to confirm the safety and effectiveness of cabotegravir in Japanese PLHIV. This was a 3-year interim analysis of post-marketing surveillance including 121 participants at 10 institutions in Japan who were virologically suppressed for over 6 months before switching to cabotegravir. During follow-up, 45 participants experienced 76 adverse drug reactions (37.19%) that included injection site pain and musculoskeletal pain (12.40% each), and oral herpes, high cholesterol, thickened or hardened injection site, fever, and decreased white blood cell counts (2.48% each). These findings were consistent with those reported in previous clinical studies. Higher adverse drug reaction rates were observed among participants aged ≥ 30 to < 40 years, those without allergy, and those with other medical conditions. Most adverse drug reactions considered related to cabotegravir occurred within 180 days after treatment initiation. Throughout the follow-up period, HIV RNA copies remained suppressed and CD4+ cell counts were maintained at levels similar to those at treatment initiation. Overall, these results confirm the real-world safety and effectiveness of cabotegravir in Japan.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines the real-world safety and effectiveness of cabotegravir, a long-acting injectable integrase strand transfer inhibitor co-administered with rilpivirine, in people living with HIV (PLHIV) in Japan, focusing on post-marketing surveillance outcomes and the central question of its clinical performance in domestic settings.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review reports a 3-year interim analysis of an ongoing post-marketing surveillance conducted in Japan from June 27, 2022 to June 17, 2025, including 121 participants at 10 institutions who were virologically suppressed for over 6 months before switching to cabotegravir. The review describes safety assessment via adverse drug reaction (ADR) incidence and associations with participant characteristics using Fisher’s exact and χ2 tests without multiplicity adjustment, and effectiveness evaluation through virologic suppression (HIV RNA copies/mL) and CD4+ cell counts.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that cabotegravir therapy is safe in Japanese PLHIV, with no new safety signals identified, and effective, as evidenced by sustained virologic suppression and stable CD4+ cell counts throughout follow-up. The most frequent ADRs were injection site pain and musculoskeletal pain (12.40% each), and serious ADRs included hepatitis B reactivation, monkeypox, syphilis, and type 2 diabetes mellitus, none explicitly deemed related to cabotegravir by reporting physicians.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights limited domestic real-world evidence for cabotegravir in Japan, as its approval relied largely on overseas and international collaborative trials. Higher ADR incidences were observed among participants aged 30 to <40 years, those without allergy, and those with comorbidities, but these associations were not adjusted for multiplicity and require further validation. The review does not report long-term safety outcomes beyond the interim analysis period.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review implies a need for continued post-marketing surveillance to confirm long-term safety and effectiveness of cabotegravir in Japanese PLHIV, particularly among subgroups with higher ADR incidence. It suggests further investigation into the mechanisms underlying ADR patterns in specific demographic and clinical subgroups, and validation of the observed associations using adjusted statistical methods.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates the real-world safety and effectiveness of cabotegravir, a long-acting injectable antiretroviral co-administered with rilpivirine, in people living with HIV (PLHIV) in Japan through a 3-year interim analysis of post-marketing surveillance. The review reports that cabotegravir therapy demonstrated no new safety signals, with sustained virologic suppression and stable CD4+ cell counts, though injection site pain and musculoskeletal pain were common adverse drug reactions. Higher adverse event rates were observed in participants aged 30 to <40 years, those without allergy, and those with comorbidities, but these findings were not adjusted for multiplicity. The review underscores the limited domestic real-world evidence for cabotegravir in Japan, as its approval relied on overseas trials, and calls for continued surveillance and subgroup-specific research to validate these interim findings.

analysis_en.scope_and_question: The review examines the real-world safety and effectiveness of cabotegravir, a long-acting injectable integrase strand transfer inhibitor co-administered with rilpivirine, in people living with HIV (PLHIV) in Japan, focusing on post-marketing surveillance outcomes and the central question of its clinical performance in domestic settings.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review reports a 3-year interim analysis of an ongoing post-marketing surveillance conducted in Japan from June 27, 2022 to June 17, 2025, including 121 participants at 10 institutions who were virologically suppressed for over 6 months before switching to cabotegravir. analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that cabotegravir therapy is safe in Japanese PLHIV, with no new safety signals identified, and effective, as evidenced by sustained virologic suppression and stable CD4+ cell counts throughout follow-up. analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights limited domestic real-world evidence for cabotegravir in Japan, as its approval relied largely on overseas and international collaborative trials. papers.title_zh: Cabotegravir 在艾滋病毒感染者中的真实安全性和有效性:日本上市后监测的中期报告。
papers.source_body_en: Cabotegravir (CAB) is an integrase strand transfer inhibitor and the first long-acting injectable antiretroviral agent for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), administered with rilpivirine. Because approval in Japan relied largely on overseas and international collaborative trials, domestic real-world evidence remains limited. This study evaluated the real-world safety and effectiveness of CAB in people living with HIV (PLHIV) in Japan. This interim analysis (June 27, 2022 and June 17, 2025) was part of an ongoing post-marketing surveillance of Japanese PLHIV treated with CAB at institutions participating in the HIV-related Drugs Cooperative Survey. Safety was assessed by the incidence of adverse drug reactions (ADRs). Associations between ADR incidence and background characteristics were examined using Fisher’s exact and χ2 tests without multiplicity adjustment. Effectiveness was evaluated using virologic suppression assessed by log-transformed HIV RNA copies/mL and peripheral CD4+ cell counts. A total of 121 and 117 participants were included in the safety and efficacy analysis sets, respectively; most were aged over 20 years, and over 96% were male participants. Overall, 76 ADRs were reported in 45 participants (37.19%). The most frequent ADRs were injection site pain and musculoskeletal pain (12.40% each). Four serious ADRs that were not explicitly deemed unrelated to CAB by the reporting physicians occurred in 4 participants: hepatitis B reactivation, monkeypox, syphilis, and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Stratification analyses by participant characteristics revealed high ADR incidences among participants aged ≥ 30 to < 40 years (p = 0.038), without allergy (p = 0.016), and with comorbidities (p = 0.045). HIV RNA copies remained suppressed and CD4+ cell counts were maintained at levels comparable to treatment initiation throughout follow-up. This interim analysis indicates that CAB therapy is safe, with no new safety signals, and effective, as demonstrated by sustained virological suppression and stable CD4+ cell counts. These findings are consistent with outcomes reported in overseas and international collaborative clinical studies. Taking multiple oral medications every day can be challenging for people living with human immunodeficiency virus (PLHIV). Cabotegravir, co-administered with rilpivirine, is the first long-acting injectable HIV treatment that can be given once monthly or every 2 months. Its approval in Japan was primarily based on overseas and international collaborative studies, and real-world clinical evidence in Japan has been limited. To address this gap, a post-marketing surveillance has been conducted to confirm the safety and effectiveness of cabotegravir in Japanese PLHIV. This was a 3-year interim analysis of post-marketing surveillance including 121 participants at 10 institutions in Japan who were virologically suppressed for over 6 months before switching to cabotegravir. During follow-up, 45 participants experienced 76 adverse drug reactions (37.19%) that included injection site pain and musculoskeletal pain (12.40% each), and oral herpes, high cholesterol, thickened or hardened injection site, fever, and decreased white blood cell counts (2.48% each). These findings were consistent with those reported in previous clinical studies. Higher adverse drug reaction rates were observed among participants aged ≥ 30 to < 40 years, those without allergy, and those with other medical conditions. Most adverse drug reactions considered related to cabotegravir occurred within 180 days after treatment initiation. Throughout the follow-up period, HIV RNA copies remained suppressed and CD4+ cell counts were maintained at levels similar to those at treatment initiation. Overall, these results confirm the real-world safety and effectiveness of cabotegravir in Japan.

papers.title: Potential Risks and Benefits of Low-Barrier Access and Monitoring for HIV Preexposure Prophylaxis: A Modeling Study.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: PrEP prevents HIV acquisition, but its population-level impact is limited by access barriers. Low-barrier delivery of daily oral tenofovir disoproxil fumarate/emtricitabine (TDF/FTC), such as over-the-counter (OTC) availability, could improve access by eliminating clinic visits, though reduced monitoring may increase risks including drug resistance, renal toxicity, and hepatitis B virus (HBV) reactivation. We estimated the benefits and risks of OTC PrEP. METHODS: Using a stochastic network-based model of HIV/STI transmission among gay, bisexual, and other men who have sex with men (GBMSM) in Atlanta, we simulated two delivery pathways: clinic-based PrEP and OTC PrEP with simplified initiation and reduced monitoring. We modeled 10-50% increases in PrEP coverage over 10 years. Outcomes included HIV infections averted, STI incidence, contraindicated PrEP use (GFR 90% without reducing prevention benefits, and frequent renal monitoring reduced renal risk. CONCLUSIONS: OTC PrEP could produce population-level HIV prevention benefits if it expands coverage beyond clinic-based care. However, its net public health impact depends on implementation choices that preserve safety functions, particularly HIV testing at initiation and renal monitoring, without undermining access gains.

papers.title: Vaccination status and associated factors among healthcare workers providing primary care: a cross-sectional study in Yaounde, Cameroon
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Healthcare workers (HCWs) are at increased risk of exposure to vaccine-preventable diseases, including hepatitis B, tuberculosis (TB), and tetanus, due to their occupational environment. Despite the availability of safe and effective vaccines, vaccination coverage among HCWs remains suboptimal in many low- and middle-income countries. This study aimed to determine the vaccination coverage for hepatitis B, tuberculosis, and tetanus among HCWs in district hospitals in Yaoundé, Cameroon, and to identify factors associated with incomplete vaccination. Methods A cross-sectional analytical study was conducted from January to June 2024 across all seven district hospitals in Yaoundé. A total of 406 HCWs were enrolled using a structured, self-administered questionnaire. Incomplete vaccination status was defined as nit having received three doses for hepatitis B, at least two doses for TB, and at least three doses for tetanus. Data were analyzed using R Statistics version 4.3.3. Bivariate and multivariate logistic regression models were used to identify predictors of incomplete vaccination, with statistical significance set at p < 0.05. Results Most of participants were female (75.6%) and aged 30-44 years (65.5%). Full vaccination coverage was 36.2% for hepatitis B, 15.8% for tuberculosis, and 53.4% for tetanus. Unvaccinated proportions were 43.1% for hepatitis B, 0.5% for tuberculosis, and 17.2% for tetanus. Multivariate analysis revealed that HCWs aged 55-66 years were significantly less likely to be incompletely vaccinated against hepatitis B compared to those aged 19-29 years (aOR = 0.07; 95% CI: 0.01-0.39; p = 0.004). Nurses and laboratory technicians were more likely to be incompletely vaccinated than doctors (aOR = 7.06; 95% CI: 3.82-13.6; p < 0.001 and aOR = 3.78; 95% CI: 1.73-8.52; p = 0.001, respectively). Longer professional experience was protective against incomplete vaccination for all three vaccines ( p < 0.05). The main barriers to vaccination included high cost, doubts about the need for vaccination, and concerns about side effects. Conclusions Vaccination coverage for hepatitis B, tuberculosis, and tetanus among HCWs in Yaoundé remains suboptimal, particularly for hepatitis B. Addressing financial barriers, improving access to vaccines, and implementing targeted educational interventions are essential to enhance vaccine uptake and protect both HCWs and their patients from preventable occupational infections.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 由于其职业环境,医护人员 (HCW) 接触疫苗可预防疾病的风险增加,包括乙型肝炎、结核病 (TB) 和破伤风。尽管可以获得安全有效的疫苗,但许多低收入和中等收入国家医护人员的疫苗接种覆盖率仍然不够理想。本研究旨在确定喀麦隆雅温得地区医院医护人员的乙型肝炎、结核病和破伤风疫苗接种覆盖率,并确定与疫苗接种不完全相关的因素。方法 2024 年 1 月至 6 月期间,对雅温得所有七家地区医院进行了横断面分析研究。共有 406 名医护人员通过结构化、自填式问卷进行了登记。不完整的疫苗接种状态定义为已接受三剂乙型肝炎疫苗、至少两剂结核病疫苗和至少三剂破伤风疫苗。使用 R Statistics 版本 4.3.3 分析数据。使用双变量和多变量逻辑回归模型来确定不完全疫苗接种的预测因素,统计显着性设置为 p < 0.05。结果 大部分参与者为女性(75.6%),年龄在30-44岁(65.5%)。乙型肝炎、结核病和破伤风疫苗的全面疫苗接种覆盖率分别为 36.2%、15.8% 和 53.4%。乙型肝炎未接种疫苗的比例为 43.1%,结核病未接种疫苗的比例为 0.5%,破伤风疫苗未接种的比例为 17.2%。多变量分析显示,与 19-29 岁的医护人员相比,55-66 岁的医护人员未完全接种乙型肝炎疫苗的可能性明显较低(aOR = 0.07;95% CI:0.01-0.39;p = 0.004)。护士和实验室技术人员比医生更有可能未完全接种疫苗(分别为 aOR = 7.06;95% CI:3.82-13.6;p < 0.001;aOR = 3.78;95% CI:1.73-8.52;p = 0.001)。较长的专业经验可以防止所有三种疫苗的疫苗接种不完全(p < 0.05)。疫苗接种的主要障碍包括成本高、对疫苗接种必要性的怀疑以及对副作用的担忧。结论 雅温得医护人员的乙型肝炎、结核病和破伤风疫苗接种覆盖率仍然不够理想,尤其是乙型肝炎。解决经济障碍、改善疫苗的获取以及实施有针对性的教育干预措施对于提高疫苗接种率并保护医护人员及其患者免受可预防的职业感染至关重要。

papers.title: Monitoring of the Cascade of Care in Patients With Chronic HBV in Primary Care Clinics in Australia.
papers.abstract: To achieve hepatitis B virus (HBV) elimination in Australia, a shift from hospital to community-based care is needed. This study aimed to describe the prevalence of chronic HBV and uptake of the cascade of care in primary care patients. This prospective cohort study was conducted in 76 urban and regional primary care clinics across Victoria, Australia between 1/7/2020 and 30/6/2023. Anonymised socio-demographic, clinical and laboratory data from general practice (GP) clinics' electronic medical records (EMR) were extracted. Descriptive analysis of the cohort of clinic clients with HBV was performed. A total of 346,927 individuals attended appointments across the study period. Of these, 25,212 had records indicating HBV-related testing. 491 (0.14%) individuals had evidence of current HBV infection defined as HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) positive and/or HBV DNA positive. 469 attended the clinics during the study period, among whom 239 (51%) were female. In the GP EMR, only 59 (13%) had evidence of at least one HBV DNA test and at least one ALT test ordered. Fourteen patients (3%) had record of being reviewed for HBV management by the clinic nurse or GP and 78 (17%) reviewed by a viral hepatitis specialist. Ninety-two (20%) were on treatment for HBV. Of people receiving treatment, 23 (25%) had a record of linkage to specialist care. Our data show that significant gaps in the cascade of care remain for people with chronic HBV in primary care settings, with a low proportion of patients having evidence of participating in all stages of the HBV cascade of care.

This study aimed to describe the prevalence of chronic HBV and uptake of the cascade of care in primary care patients. This prospective cohort study was conducted in 76 urban and regional primary care clinics across Victoria, Australia between 1/7/2020 and 30/6/2023. Anonymised socio-demographic, clinical and laboratory data from general practice (GP) clinics' electronic medical records (EMR) were extracted. Descriptive analysis of the cohort of clinic clients with HBV was performed. A total of 346,927 individuals attended appointments across the study period. Of these, 25,212 had records indicating HBV-related testing. 491 (0.14%) individuals had evidence of current HBV infection defined as HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) positive and/or HBV DNA positive. 469 attended the clinics during the study period, among whom 239 (51%) were female. In the GP EMR, only 59 (13%) had evidence of at least one HBV DNA test and at least one ALT test ordered. Fourteen patients (3%) had record of being reviewed for HBV management by the clinic nurse or GP and 78 (17%) reviewed by a viral hepatitis specialist. Ninety-two (20%) were on treatment for HBV. Of people receiving treatment, 23 (25%) had a record of linkage to specialist care. Our data show that significant gaps in the cascade of care remain for people with chronic HBV in primary care settings, with a low proportion of patients having evidence of participating in all stages of the HBV cascade of care.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in primary care settings in Australia, focusing on the cascade of care for patients with chronic HBV. The central question addresses the prevalence of chronic HBV and the uptake of the cascade of care (testing, monitoring, treatment, and specialist linkage) within primary care clinics.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a prospective cohort study conducted in 76 urban and regional primary care clinics across Victoria, Australia, between 1 July 2020 and 30 June 2023. Anonymised socio-demographic, clinical, and laboratory data were extracted from general practice electronic medical records (EMR). Descriptive analysis was performed on the cohort of clinic clients with HBV.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review reports that 491 (0.14%) of 346,927 individuals had evidence of current HBV infection (HBsAg positive and/or HBV DNA positive). Among 469 patients attending clinics during the study period, only 59 (13%) had evidence of at least one HBV DNA test and at least one ALT test ordered. Fourteen patients (3%) had records of being reviewed for HBV management by the clinic nurse or GP, and 78 (17%) were reviewed by a viral hepatitis specialist. Ninety-two (20%) were on treatment for HBV, of whom 23 (25%) had a record of linkage to specialist care.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights significant gaps in the cascade of care for chronic HBV in primary care, including low rates of testing (25,212 of 346,927 individuals tested), limited monitoring (13% with HBV DNA and ALT tests), infrequent management reviews (3% by clinic staff, 17% by specialists), and suboptimal treatment linkage (25% of treated patients linked to specialist care). The supplied evidence does not report reasons for these gaps or strategies to address them.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review implies a need for targeted interventions to improve HBV testing, monitoring, and management in primary care settings. Specific priorities include enhancing HBV DNA and ALT testing rates, increasing specialist linkage for treated patients, and strengthening clinic-based HBV management reviews to address the identified gaps in the cascade of care.

analysis.summary_en: This review examines the cascade of care for chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) in Australian primary care clinics, focusing on prevalence, testing, monitoring, treatment, and specialist linkage. Among 346,927 individuals, 0.14% had current HBV infection, with only 13% undergoing recommended HBV DNA and ALT testing. Management reviews were infrequent (3% by clinic staff, 17% by specialists), and 20% of patients were on treatment, though only 25% of treated patients had specialist linkage. Significant gaps persist in the cascade of care, underscoring the need for interventions to improve testing, monitoring, and management in primary care.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述调查了澳大利亚初级保健机构中的慢性乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染,重点关注慢性乙型肝炎患者的级联护理。核心问题涉及慢性乙型肝炎的患病率以及初级保健诊所内级联护理(检测、监测、治疗和专家联系)的采用。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该评价是一项前瞻性队列研究,于 2020 年 7 月 1 日至 2023 年 6 月 30 日期间在澳大利亚维多利亚州 76 个城市和地区初级保健诊所进行。匿名社会人口统计、临床和实验室数据是从全科电子病历 (EMR) 中提取的。对患有 HBV 的临床客户队列进行了描述性分析。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该审查报告称,346,927 名个体中有 491 名(0.14%)有当前 HBV 感染的证据(HBsAg 阳性和/或 HBV DNA 阳性)。在研究期间到诊所就诊的 469 名患者中,只有 59 名患者 (13%) 拥有至少一项 HBV DNA 检测和至少一项 ALT 检测的证据。14 名患者 (3%) 有诊所护士或全科医生对 HBV 管理进行审查的记录,78 名患者 (17%) 接受了病毒性肝炎专家的审查。92 人 (20%) 正在接受 HBV 治疗,其中 23 人 (25%) 有接受专科护理的记录。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该审查强调了初级保健中慢性乙型肝炎护理级联方面的显着差距,包括检测率低(346,927 人中的 25,212 人接受了检测)、监测有限(13% 进行了 HBV DNA 和 ALT 检测)、不频繁的管理审查(3% 由临床工作人员进行,17% 由专家进行)以及治疗联系不理想(25% 的治疗患者与专科护理相关)。所提供的证据没有报告这些差距的原因或解决这些差距的策略。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该审查意味着需要采取有针对性的干预措施来改善初级保健机构的乙型肝炎检测、监测和管理。具体优先事项包括提高 HBV DNA 和 ALT 检测率、加强与治疗患者的专家联系,以及加强基于临床的 HBV 管理审查,以解决级联护理中已发现的差距。

papers.title: High-resolution mapping of chromatin conformation in HBeAg-treated macrophage provides insights into pathogenesis of HBV-related liver diseases
papers.abstract: Background Hepatitis B virus (HBV) e antigen (HBeAg) plays a critical role in inducing macrophage activation and subsequent immune tolerance, which facilitates viral immune escape. However, the underlying spatial 3D genomic and epigenetic mechanisms driving this macrophage dysfunction remain largely unknown. Methods To map the topological and transcriptional regulatory landscape, we integrated RNA-sequencing (RNA-seq), high-throughput chromosome conformation capture (Hi-C), and chromatin immunoprecipitation-sequencing (ChIP-seq) to comprehensively analyze control and HBeAg-stimulated macrophages. Key findings were cross-validated using human HBV-infected datasets. Result HBeAg robustly activated pro-inflammatory transcriptional programs, prominently featuring the TNF signaling pathway as a central node. Hi-C analysis revealed profound global 3D chromatin reorganization accompanying this phenotypic shift. Specifically, inactive-to-active (B-to-A) compartment switching, coupled with de novo H3K27ac enhancer accumulation, directly drove the upregulation of functional genes such as MET and FHOD3. Furthermore, topologically associating domain (TAD) restructuring, particularly TAD merging, exposed new regulatory elements to upregulate FLNB and SESN2. Conversely, the disruption of specific intrachromosomal loops resulted in the targeted downregulation of genes like KBTBD11 and BLVRB. Mechanistically, targeted epigenetic reprogramming drove this 3D structural rewiring: H3K27ac enhancer deposition was enriched for AP-1/STAT motifs, CTCF coordinated with FOX-family factors to alter structural boundaries, and HLTF mediated targeted H3K27me3-associated gene silencing. Conclusion HBeAg orchestrates a highly coordinated hierarchical restructuring of the 3D genome and targeted epigenetic reprogramming to induce macrophage dysfunction. The identified structural variants and core spatial-target genes (such as MET, FLNB, and BLVRB) provide novel mechanistic insights and represent potential therapeutic targets for HBV-related liver diseases.
